jobs.title: Senior Hazardous Materials Consultant
jobs.description:
* Role with genuine project ownership \& technical responsibility
* Company Vehicle, competitive salary, overtime
* Strong career development with the backing of global Kiwa group


  

Kiwa ELS is a customer\-focused, results\-driven risk management consultancy with offices in Brisbane and Sydney. We deliver hazardous materials, occupational hygiene, environmental and risk management consulting services to clients across Australia.  

  

As part of the Kiwa Group—a global leader in testing, inspection and certification with more than 12,000 professionals across 35\+ countries—we offer the backing of an international organisation while maintaining a strong local presence.  

  

Working alongside our NATA\-accredited laboratory, our Hazardous Materials team provides asbestos, mould and hazardous materials management, assessment and advisory services to an established client base across the construction, facilities management, transport, insurance and government sectors.  

  

Due to continued growth, we are seeking a full\-time Senior Hazardous Materials Consultant to join our Brisbane\-based team.  

  

Approximately 60% of your time will be spent on site across Southeast Queensland, undertaking hazardous materials and occupational hygiene work. The remaining 40% will be office\-based and focused on technical reporting, project management, proposals, quality assurance and supporting the development of other consultants. Occasional travel to regional locations and interstate may also be required.  

  

**What you will be doing**  

* Conduct asbestos, mould and hazardous materials surveys across industrial, commercial and residential properties.
* Undertake clearance inspections and airborne asbestos fibre monitoring associated with asbestos removal work.
* Complete contamination and post\-remediation verification assessments for asbestos, mould, moisture and other contaminants.
* Conduct occupational hygiene surveys and monitoring
* Manage projects, including developing scopes of work, preparing fee proposals, coordinating resources and ensuring project objectives and deadlines are achieved.
* Produce clear, accurate hazardous materials and occupational hygiene reports.
* Undertake technical review and quality assurance of reports prepared by other consultants.
* Provide technical guidance, training and mentoring to less experienced consultants.
* Liaise with clients and stakeholders to understand project requirements and provide practical technical advice.
* Perform laboratory analysis, including fibre counting for airborne asbestos, where required.
* Conduct respirator face fit testing when required.
* Ensure client deliverables are completed accurately and within agreed timeframes.
* Quality Assurance support when required

**Why work with us?**  

* Company vehicle provided.
* Competitive salary \& overtime based on your experience.
* Senior position with genuine project ownership and technical responsibility.
* Opportunity to mentor and support the development of other consultants.
* Ongoing training and career development opportunities.
* Kiwa Rewards, including discounts on shopping, travel, insurance and more.
* Access to our Employee Assistance Program.
* Supportive local team with the backing of a global organisation.


  

**Experience and qualifications**  

* 3\+ years’ experience in hazardous materials consulting, occupational hygiene or a closely related field.
* A current LAA licence is essential.
* A current Australian driver’s licence is essential.
* Science, environmental or hazardous materials qualifications, including relevant P\-Certs, are desirable.
* Professional membership with AIOH, FAMANZ or a similar industry body will be highly regarded.
* Demonstrated experience preparing and reviewing technical reports.
* Experience managing projects, developing scopes and preparing fee proposals will be highly regarded.

**About you**  

* Strong asbestos and/or Occ Hygiene background \- Technically strong and confident providing advice to clients, contractors and other consultants.
* Comfortable balancing hands\-on fieldwork with reporting, project management and technical review.
* Well organised and capable of managing multiple projects, priorities and deadlines.
* Able to communicate clearly and professionally with a broad range of stakeholders.
* Confident mentoring and providing constructive technical feedback to other consultants.
* Practical, safety\-focused and detail\-oriented.
* Able to work independently while contributing positively to the wider team.

If you are an experienced hazardous materials professional looking for a senior role that combines fieldwork, project ownership and technical leadership, apply now to join the Kiwa ELS team.

### **Location: California**


Aspen Environmental Group is seeking an experienced and motivated Air Quality Specialist to support projects focused primarily on CEQA/NEPA analysis, air quality impact modeling, and greenhouse gas emissions inventory evaluations. The Air Quality Specialist will work as part of a multidisciplinary environmental team and collaborate with other recognized experts.


Aspen’s Air Quality \& Climate Services group supports environmental compliance projects, including Air Quality Impact Analysis, Compliance Audit Evaluations, and Climate Change Analysis. Learn more about our Air Quality \& Climate Services at: https://www.aspeneg.com/service/air\-quality\-climate\-services

#### **Required Education and Experience**

* B.S. degree in Engineering (Environmental, Civil, Chemical, or Mechanical) or Science (Environmental, Atmospheric, Meteorological, Chemistry, Toxicology, or Data Science) required; M.S. and/or P.E. a plus.
* Minimum of 5 to 8 years of direct consulting, public agency, or industry experience in air quality\-related aspects of CEQA/NEPA services.

#### **Key Responsibilities**

* Write environmental impact analyses, assess regulatory compliance, and perform regulatory applicability evaluations.
* Write evaluations of complex air quality impact analyses, compliance, and permitting situations.
* Perform multiple tasks within scope, budget, and schedule expectations and ensure quality standards on project deliverables.
* Communicate environmental standards to management and/or clients.
* Interact and maintain successful relationships with clients, in\-house project managers and staff, and subcontractors.
* Work independently and with teams to complete assignments.
* Deliver assignments on time and within the allotted budget.
* Engage in business development efforts.

#### **Qualifications for Success**

* Subject matter expertise in air pollution principles, air quality impact analysis methodologies, greenhouse gas emissions inventory development and management strategies, and California policies and regulatory programs of local air districts and the state.
* Actively stays informed regarding the changing regulatory landscape in California.
* Experience with AERMOD dispersion modeling and related software for ambient impact evaluation and health risk assessment.
* Ability to work independently while maintaining a strong focus on environmental protection, health, safety, quality, budget, and schedule.
* Highly developed organizational skills, with attention to both the big picture and detail, to meet competing deadlines and demands.
* Excellent technical writing and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to succeed in a fast\-paced consulting environment, handle multiple project assignments, and meet strict deadlines.
* Success in new business development preferred.
* Proficiency in Excel, Word, and basic computer skills required.

#### **Compensation**


The pay range for this role is $97,000 \- $130,000 commensurate with experience.

#### **To Apply**


Please submit a letter of interest, resume, references, and a recent writing sample in which the candidate was the sole author to humanresources@aspeneg.com. The subject line must state, “Air Quality Specialist – \[NAME].”

The Bay Area Air Quality Management District (Air District) is a regional government agency, committed to achieving clean air to protect the public's health and the environment. The Air District's jurisdiction encompasses all of seven counties \- Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara and Napa, and portions of two others \- southwestern Solano and southern Sonoma.
  

  

The Air District is currently accepting applications for the position of Senior Air Quality Specialist in the Regulatory Development Division. This is an open recruitment for one (1\) full\-time, represented position.


**About the Position**


The Senior Air Quality Specialist will serve as lead in reviewing and drafting regulatory language for various air quality rule programs; work closely with professional and technical staff to interpret complex scientific research and economic and environmental analyses and technical work for developing regulations to control air pollutants (including those contributing to climate change and contributing to localize air quality impacts in overburdened communities).


Develop and implement cost effectiveness and incremental cost effectiveness calculations for a wide variety of sources in industry with a variety of control options; analyze emissions inventories to determine baseline emissions and reduction estimates for rules under development; brief District executives and present at workshops, committee and board meetings; work closely with the Community Engagement Section staff and other Air District divisions to strengthen partnerships with key community stakeholders; perform related work as assigned.


The Regulatory Development Division works with all levels of the Air District, including staff, management, executives, and Board members in developing and modifying Air District rules to provide emissions reductions to improve air quality both regionally and at the neighborhood level and protect the climate. ### **Job Description and Duties**


Under the direction of the Nutria Eradication Operations Supervisor, the incumbent will serve as one of the lead field scientists for the Nutria Eradication Program. Nutria are highly invasive and extremely detrimental to the environment, but primarily nocturnal and relatively elusive in low densities. This position will play a critical role in the coordination of field crews conducting nutria surveys and trapping across the southern portion of the nutria infestation. The incumbent will assist the Operations Supervisor with training, leading, and evaluating field crew technicians and scientific aides to survey for, detect, and remove nutria, with the ultimate goal of eradicating nutria from the State of California. The incumbent will lead the team by example in conducting habitat suitability assessments, visual observation and camera surveys, trapping, and electronic data collection (i.e., ESRI Field Maps smartphone application), as well as effective use of baits and lures and obtaining entry permits from local landowners. The incumbent is responsible for conducting morning briefings of the assigned crew, tracking daily spatial assignments, and ensuring field staff understand understand project protocols. The incumbent will work with the Operations Supervisors, other field crew leads, and Planning Specialist to evaluate and help refine detection and trapping methods and tools for the most effective and efficient detection and removal of nutria. The incumbent will also closely coordinate with other regions and Department functions, as well as other affected and involved local, State, and Federal agencies. Work includes preparing draft reports and correspondence and answering routine questions from the public relative to Departmental nutria efforts. The primary geographical focus of this position will be in Fresno, Madera, Merced, Stanislaus, Tuolumne, Kings, Kern, and Mariposa counties, but work may be assigned in any part of the area of nutria infestation. This position is physically demanding, but highly rewarding given the ultimate accomplishment of protecting California's wetlands, waterways, infrastructure, and agriculture from the devastation nutria have caused in other regions of North America.
Incumbent must be willing and able to competently use firearms as per the Department’s Policy for Non\-Enforcement Personnel. Must be willing and able to competently use and possess wildlife restraint drugs and equipment. Must wear a Department uniform.

Must be willing and able to competently use pellet pistols or firearms as per the Department’s Policy for Non\-Enforcement Personnel. Willing to handle live animals and carcasses, dispatch animals, and conduct simple tissue sampling and necropsies. Must possess valid Driver's License and be able to safely and effectively operate watercraft and and Utility Task Vehicles (UTV)s, as well as tow trailers. This job requires daily operation of State vehicles to reach field sites, regular use of kayaks, and occasional operation of UTVs and motorized watercraft. Must wear Department uniform. Must be willing and able to obtain a California Boater Card and other motorboat operator certifications as determined necessary.  

  

  

The primary geographical focus of this position will be in Fresno, Madera, Merced, Stanislaus, Tuolumne, Kings, Kern, and Mariposa counties, but work may be assigned in any part of the area of nutria infestation.

**SUMMARY OF POSITION**
The Environmental Health Bureau sits within the County of Monterey’s Department of Health and consists of seven major environmental health regulatory programs: Healthy Housing Services, Consumer Health Protection Services, Drinking Water Protection Services, Environmental Health Review (Land Use) Services, Hazardous Materials Management Services, Recycling and Resource Recovery Services, and Solid Waste Management Services.  

  

The Environmental Health Bureau is seeking to fill one full\-time Environmental Health Specialist IV (EHS IV) for the Healthy Housing Services program.  

  

The Healthy Housing Services program is responsible for ensuring safe and healthy living environments through the inspection and enforcement of state and local housing regulations for residential rental housing, employee housing, detention facilities, and other regulated facilities. The program investigates housing complaints, addresses substandard housing conditions, conducts vector control and agricultural field toilet inspections, supports the Childhood Lead Poisoning Prevention Program, and performs other environmental health activities designed to protect community health and prevent environmental health hazards.  

  

The EHS IV is a supervisory/leadership position whose primary responsibility is to actively support the Director of Environmental Health's goals and vision by performing supervisory tasks such as administrative oversight and quality assurance of environmental health programs. Subordinate staff provide enforcement of environmental public health laws by conducting field inspections, project reviews and report writing. This role is to ensure activities are completed by providing timely feedback to staff while reviewing their work, spotting trends, and ensuring proper follow\-up. jobs.title: Associate Creative Director, Copy (Remote US)
jobs.description:
**THE ROLE**


Directive is a revenue\-first marketing consultancy built to serve B2B SaaS, enterprise technology, industrial, and commerce brands. We don't make things look good for its own sake. We build visual systems that hold up under the pressure of performance channels, complex professional services positioning, and a buying audience that starts with a CMO and ends with a CFO.


We are looking for an Associate Creative Director who will translate Moments that Matter into creative territories, messaging hypotheses, campaign concepts, headlines, CTAs, and copy direction that designers can execute against. The Associate Creative Director will bring senior\-level creative judgment to work that is fast\-moving, digital\-first, and tied directly to business outcomes. This person will not simply wait for polished briefs or execute one\-off design requests. They will help shape the ask, identify stronger creative angles, and translate strategic inputs into assets that feel clear, compelling, and differentiated. They will represent creative in strategic new\-business and portfolio\-sales opportunities, help build speculative and portfolio creative, and support Directive’s move toward campaign\-style case studies that can drive account growth and new revenue.


This is an individual contributor role — no direct reports — but the work will be high\-visibility and the standard will be high. The ideal candidate is copywriting\-led and campaign\-minded. They should have enough executive presence to participate in client and leadership conversations, but remain hands\-on enough to write copy, review briefs, develop messaging territories, and shape creative direction without needing a fully staffed creative team around them. They should understand performance creative as a system of hypotheses, tests, learnings, and scalable winners—not just brand execution or asset quality.


Success means helping Directive replace deliverable\-based requests with campaign briefs grounded in business objectives, buyer insight, test variables, and success metrics. The ACD should raise the quality of creative thinking before work reaches production, improve how Directive communicates to technical and enterprise buyers, and create the foundation for a scalable performance creative practice.

 **WILL OWN**

**Campaign Strategy**


The ACD owns the idea, message, and creative direction before production begins — and helps prove that better campaign thinking can create better performance, stronger pitches, and more creative revenue.

* Support new\-business and portfolio\-sales opportunities with speculative creative, campaign narratives, and stronger creative presence in strategic pitches.
* Create the foundation for Directive’s strategic creative approach.
* Primary responsibility is creative direction, campaign concepting, messaging strategy, and performance copy direction.
* Turns campaign and creative briefs into territories, concepts, hooks, headlines, CTAs, landing\-page narrative direction, and message sequencing.
* Partners with designers by giving them a strong concept and copy direction to execute against.
* Builds the early proof points, examples, and campaign\-style case studies needed to support future creative revenue growth.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

**30\-day success signal:** Internal teams understand why this role exists, what it owns, and how creative requests should start shifting from asset asks to campaign briefs.

* Audited current creative requests, briefs, production workflows, pitch materials, and performance creative examples.
* Met with Creative Production, Paid Media, Growth, Sales, Account leadership, and executive stakeholders to understand opportunities.
* Defined what a “good” campaign brief needs to include before work enters production.
* Created a first draft of the campaign creative brief template tied to Moments that Matter / Stratos.
* Identified 2–3 priority use cases where the new model can prove value quickly, such as strategic account pitches, paid social campaigns, ABM campaigns, or portfolio\-sales opportunities.
* Produced at least one example of a stronger campaign territory or messaging direction from an existing work.

jobs.title: Chemical Safety Expert for AI Model Safety Audit
jobs.description:
\#\# Description SME Careers is hiring chemists and chemical safety professionals to audit how AI models respond to sensitive questions in the field. Each task gives you a user request and the answers three different models gave to it. You classify the request (benign, dual\-use or adversarial), mark each answer as safe or unsafe and say why, rank the three against each other, and write the answer the model should have given. For dual\-use requests you also note what makes it sensitive, what legitimate purpose it serves, and who should be able to get an answer. The requests are realistic: what synthetic and analytical chemists, toxicologists, industrial hygienists, process safety engineers, regulators and occasionally bad actors actually ask. Some are ordinary professional questions that models wrongly refuse, and catching those matters as much as catching the dangerous ones. \#\# Who we're looking for Synthetic and analytical chemists; toxicologists and pharmacologists; industrial hygienists and chemical safety/process safety professionals; CWC or chemical\-security specialists; hazmat, poison\-control or chemical incident responders; and chemical regulators (EPA, OSHA, HSE, OPCW\-adjacent, or equivalent). Usually a relevant degree plus five or more years of professional experience. Experience with safety data sheets, exposure assessment, incident reports or regulatory review is a strong plus. \#\# Before you apply Open only to citizens or permanent residents of the US, UK, Canada, Australia, New Zealand and the European Union.

**Description**


**About the role**


We currently have an exciting opportunity for a **Senior Environmental Scientist** to join our **Contaminated Land** team. Our team is experienced in planning and executing environmental site assessment and remediation projects which improve the health and wellbeing of the communities that we live in.


In this role, you’ll provide strategic and practical solutions to clients with a broad range of environmental management challenges under the guidance of an experienced Project Director. Your role will predominantly include interpretation of technical data, preparation of technical reports, and presenting information in a clear and logical manner, with additional opportunities in project management, planning and delivery. You will primarily work on a large fuel facility remediation program, involving complex and unique approaches to site assessment, management and remediation. You will also be involved in varied and interesting projects, ranging from industrial and Defence sites to greenfields and brownfields redevelopments, groundwater hydrogeology investigations, and multi\-disciplinary infrastructure projects.


This position is based in our Melbourne CBD, with flexibility including work from home and staggered hours. We offer strong support for your professional development through mentoring, training, and opportunities to attend industry events and conferences.


**Day to day tasks would involve:**


* Technical leadership including analytical data interpretation, and technical reporting.
* Project management of contaminated land projects including planning and execution of fieldwork, co\-ordination of internal resources, contractor management, budget management and client correspondence.
* Assist with the scope, design and costing of contaminated land and groundwater investigations.
* Provide mentoring and training to graduates and junior professionals throughout the delivery of your projects.
* Lead the preparation of technical reports, focused on presenting information in a clear and logical manner, supported by appropriate interpretation of technical data in accordance with relevant guidelines and legislation.
* Assist in undertaking fieldwork which may involve sampling of environmental media (e.g. soil, groundwater, surface water or soil vapour), undertaking hydrogeological investigations, or supervision of subcontractors conducting works such as drilling, excavation or remediation activities *(This role is predominantly a Project management and technical role; however, some fieldwork and/or field mentoring will be required).*

**To be successful for this role you'll need:**


* Degree in Environmental Science/Engineering, Geology, Hydrogeology, Environmental Chemistry or related field.
* 5\-15 years’ experience within the field of contaminated land assessment and/or environmental assessment and remediation.
* Strong technical reporting, analytical interpretation, and written communication skills.
* Demonstrated experience in site supervision, managing site investigations and various sampling methods including soil and groundwater
* Demonstrated project management experience, including verbal communication skills, business acumen to manage projects commercially and to create meaningful relationships with clients
* Valid/current driver’s licence and the ability to travel to sites for field work

We’re a product-driven creative company with an in-house engineering team that builds tools to test, learn, and scale what works. We combine strategy, creative, and AI to turn insights into systems, helping brands move faster and make better decisions across every channel.



The RoleThis is a senior leadership role for someone who can sit at the center of client growth, creative performance, and internal execution, and make all three move faster.

Your job is not simply to oversee deliverables.

Your job is to make sure the work we put into client accounts wins.

That means understanding the client’s business deeply, recognizing that what they ask for is not always what they actually need, and having the strategic confidence to redirect, refine, and shape the work into something that outperforms what is already running.

You must be equally comfortable:

leading creative direction,

building testing strategy,

pitching directly to clients,

managing high-level relationships,

pushing back when necessary,

and translating all of that into clear internal execution.

This is a hands-on operator role.

You cannot lead this from above.

You must know how to build strategy, create strong concepts, understand AI production, and step into the work yourself when needed. The team should move faster because your expertise is in the room.

This role sits at the intersection of:

creative leadership, performance strategy, client trust, and speed.

The pace is aggressive.

Clients move fast. Ad accounts move faster. So do we.

jobs.title: Founding Content Strategist
jobs.description:
Meet Siena

Siena is the Agent of Record for CX, built for consumer brands like Spanx, FIGS, Brooklinen, and Grüns.

It runs as a connected multi-agent stack on top of a shared intelligence layer: agents that sell, support, listen, handle social and voice across the entire customer journey, turning every conversation into signal you can act on.

The team

We are a small, fully distributed, global team. We have built leverage into how we work, which is what lets a team this size move at the speed we do.

We hire athletes. Everyone here owns real outcomes, defaults to writing over meetings, communicates with directness, and acts the moment they see something worth acting on. Low ego, high standards, fast clock.

If you want to set the bar rather than follow one, keep reading.

The Role

Siena is shipping faster than the market can absorb, and the words are not keeping up. The market learns about what we build too late, and when it does, the writing doesn't do the product justice. Today launch content is written by the founders and the growth team between everything else, and nobody owns it.

With several product launches back to back over the next two quarters and a Founding Creative Director coming in to own the visuals, we need one person who owns every word Siena puts in front of the market: founder-led LinkedIn, the company voice on socials, launches, blog posts, announcements, the scripts behind our videos.

You decide what we say, where, and how often, and then you write it. There is no content team underneath you and no copywriters to hand things to. You make the thing.

What You'll Do

You own all of Siena's content: if it goes out under the Siena name and the market reads it, you wrote it or you signed off on it.
You set the strategy for founder-led LinkedIn and the company's own social accounts, write the posts, and own what they do.
You ship every product launch with its words ready, announcement, blog, social sequence and founder posts, working with the Creative Director so the words and the visuals land as one thing.
You write the scripts for every product video and marketing video, from the launch film to a 30-second product clip, and the Creative Director brings them to screen.
You study trends and top performing posts, in our category and outside it, and turn that into a point of view the team can act on, not a swipe file.
You know which content moved something, why, and where to double down, and you kill what doesn't work without being asked.
You use AI in every part of the work, research, drafting, analysis, distribution, and move faster than a content team would. Your taste is the final filter.

Who You Are

The Bar:
If you're missing any of these, this isn't the role for you.

Published writing you can show across blog posts, launch announcements, social, and video scripts.
You have shipped content as the only writer at a company or brand, with no team or copywriters behind you.
You have worked in eCommerce or marketed to consumer brands and understand how their teams operate.

Strong Signal:
Not dealbreakers, but what separates a good hire from a great one.

You were writing professionally before the current AI tools, and you can tell the difference between a sentence that sounds right and one that's true.
You can point to writing that changed what someone did, e.g. the line that got a head of CX to book the demo, the founder post that got forwarded inside a company, the launch that landed.
You use AI in every part of your work and none of it reads like AI.
You measure your own work and change course on the evidence, not on taste alone.
You have run founder-led or executive content before and can show what it did.

Nice to Have:
Bonus, not required.

CX experience in eCommerce, on the brand side or the vendor side.
You have marketed AI, automation, or customer experience products.

Not a Fit If:

You need a content team or copywriters underneath you to produce output.
You think content strategy is a calendar. A calendar isn't a point of view.
You are anti-AI, or you use AI and ship the first draft. Both are disqualifying.
Your best work happens on a slow, protected timeline. Here it's multiple launches in flight and feedback in hours, not weeks.

Why Siena?

Real ownership. You will own problems, not tasks, with the autonomy to solve them your way and the trust to do it without a manager in your inbox.

Work that ships and matters. What you build reaches real consumer brands fast.

A category we are creating. The Agent of Record is new ground, with unsolved problems and cutting-edge models, not a crowded field to compete in.

A team that respects your judgment. Globally distributed, async-first, low bureaucracy. We hire adults and treat you like one.

Great salary plus equity or stock grants. Own a piece of what you build.

Learning budget. If you are growing, so are we.

AI-fluency by default. Few places will push your work with production AI further or faster.

Our values

The people who thrive here are curious, customer-obsessed, and take ownership without being asked. They fix problems first and explain later. They're direct about feedback - both giving and receiving it - because they care more about getting things right than being polite.

They maintain high standards while moving at startup speed, and they build real relationships with teammates because they know that's how great work gets done. When things get tough, they adapt and keep pushing forward.

Our approach to AI

The people who thrive here treat AI like a natural extension of themselves. They've built their own ecosystem of agents - some for research, others for debugging, writing, analysis, or writing code. They know which AI works best for what problem.

Everyone gets premium accounts (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity Pro, Cursor, Lovable) plus a quarterly budget for new tools. But the magic happens in how we share knowledge. Demo days where someone shows off a clever workflows. Slack threads about which model handles a specific use case better. Learning from each other's AI workflows.

At Siena, we're not just looking for people who can do a job. We're looking for people who want to break boundaries, create the future, and reshape industries. If that's you, we look forward to your application.

How We Hire

We use AI-assisted screening tools as part of our hiring process. All decisions are made by humans. You can request a human-only review at talent@siena.cx.

Siena provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

We are a performance marketing agency that helps law firms acquire signed retainers. In this role, you will develop creative angles, write detailed production briefs, direct our video editors and content team, and use performance data to determine which concepts should be scaled, improved, or replaced.
This position focuses on creative strategy and day-to-day creative direction. It does not include hiring, personnel management, or media buying responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop new advertising concepts, hooks, and creative angles each week.
• Decide which concepts should be produced, scaled, improved, or replaced.
• Research competitor advertising and relevant industry trends.
• Ensure concepts comply with Meta advertising policies and legal advertising requirements before production.
• Write detailed production briefs covering hooks, structure, pacing, copy, calls to action, and visual direction.
• Write scripts and develop storyboards for video and creator-led content.
• Provide day-to-day creative direction to video editors and the content team.
• Review completed assets and provide clear, actionable written feedback.
• Plan and execute creative tests across hooks, formats, and messaging angles.
• Analyze creative performance using metrics such as hook rate, click-through rate, cost per lead, and cost per signed retainer.
• Collaborate with the media buyer on weekly planning and creative decisions.
• Maintain an organized library of tested angles, hooks, spend, and performance results.

Required Qualifications

• Four or more years of experience in creative strategy within a performance marketing agency or in-house performance team.
• Proven experience writing production briefs for video editors and designers.
• Strong understanding of creative performance metrics, including hook rate, CTR, CPL, and cost per acquisition or signed retainer.
• Excellent English communication and copywriting skills, with the ability to write natural, conversational hooks.
• Working knowledge of Meta advertising policies.
• Experience directing UGC creators or influencers.
• Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager, Notion, and Slack.
• Strong organizational skills and the ability to meet deadlines without constant follow-up.
• Full-time availability. This position cannot be combined with other client engagements.

What Success Looks Like

• Production briefs are delivered on schedule, and editors consistently have clear direction.
• New creative concepts are tested every week, with results properly documented.
• Cost per acquisition improves over time.
• The creative library remains current and clearly shows what has been tested and the results produced.
• Potential compliance issues are identified before production rather than after an ad is rejected.
• The co-founder can step away from day-to-day creative direction.

Work Environment

Remote, full-time position.

jobs.title: UGC Creator Needed for Real Estate Ads (Real People Only, NO AI Actors) - Raw Footage
jobs.description:
**UGC Creator Needed for Real Estate Facebook Ads (Real People Only, NO AI Actors) - Raw Footage**

We're looking for a real UGC creator to record authentic, selfie-style videos for our real estate Facebook and Instagram ad campaigns.

**Please note:** We are only accepting real, on-camera UGC creators. AI-generated avatars, AI voiceovers, synthetic videos, or any AI-created content will not be considered.

## Project Details

• Industry: Real Estate

• Usage: Paid advertising on Facebook and Instagram

• Estimated filming time: Approximately 2 hours

• Filming style: Natural iPhone selfie-style videos that feel authentic and conversational, as if you're talking to a friend. Avoid making the videos feel overly scripted or like a commercial.

• Delivery: Raw footage only (no editing required)

• Timeline: Flexible

## What You'll Be Recording

You'll receive 3 different scripts, each approximately 30–40 seconds long.

Each script will be recorded in 3 different locations (for example: inside your home, outside, in your car, office, or another natural setting).

The script itself will stay exactly the same. The only thing that changes is the filming location and the overall setting to create more variety for our ad creatives.

To help the videos feel more authentic, we encourage natural camera movement whenever it makes sense. Walking while talking, slightly moving the phone, changing your angle naturally, or filming in locations with some background activity are all great ways to make the content feel more dynamic. We want the videos to look like genuine UGC, not a polished commercial.

It's perfectly okay to glance away from the camera naturally from time to time, just as you would during a normal conversation. The goal is to sound relaxed and authentic rather than feeling like you're reading from a script.

## Wardrobe

We recommend a clean, professional, business casual look.

Since each script is filmed in 3 different locations, we'd like you to wear a different shirt in each location. You can absolutely reuse the same shirts throughout the project, as long as each location has a different look. This helps make each video feel like it was filmed on different days and gives us more creative variety for testing ads.

## Deliverables

• 3 unique scripts

• 3 filming locations per script

• 9 raw videos total (30–40 seconds each)

Scripts:

https://docs.google.com/document/d/1lOx8vKYYnA13V16P-Svpr21eFttctajm8rDMy9HFA54/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.i989s9wxjtj5

## To Apply

Please include:

• Examples of previous UGC or selfie-style videos you've created.

• A portfolio, media kit, or any presentation showcasing your previous work.

• The type of phone you'll be filming with (iPhone preferred).

• Your estimated turnaround time.

We're looking for someone who is comfortable speaking naturally on camera and can create authentic, engaging content that performs well in paid advertising. If you're a good fit, we'd love to see your application!

jobs.title: Performance Creative Strategist (all genders)(EN)
jobs.description:
YOUR CREATIVE FIELD

We are looking for a full-time, permanent Performance Creative Strategist to start as soon as possible. We live remote-first, but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations (Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, Munich).

As our new Performance Creative Strategist, you will own one of the most direct levers of growth at Contabo Group, a profitable, fast-growing European cloud infrastructure provider backed by KKR and Oakley Capital. Across Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube, you will decide which ideas get tested, which assets get built, and which concepts get scaled, giving you real ownership and real impact from day one.

You develop and execute creative strategies for every paid channel we run, translating audience insights and funnel data into sharp, performance-driven briefs. From there, you brief and collaborate closely with designers, copywriters, and video producers to bring those concepts to life, and you build the A/B and multivariate testing frameworks that tell us which ones actually win. You read the numbers behind every creative (CTR, CVR, CPA, ROAS), know when to kill a concept and when to scale it, and turn those insights into channel-specific playbooks the whole team can build on.

Because we operate in B2B cloud infrastructure, this role comes with its own puzzle: turning technical, often complex value propositions into ad concepts people actually stop scrolling for. You stay close to platform updates, algorithm shifts, and creative trends across every channel we use, and translate all of it into a systematic testing framework rather than gut feeling.

You will report directly to our Head of Performance Marketing and work within an international, English-speaking team with a flat hierarchy, where you build creative processes from scratch rather than inheriting a rigid one. As we grow, so does the scope of this role, giving you real visibility and a fast path toward owning creative strategy end to end.

WHAT CONVINCES US

Your personality, paired with:

Senior track record at the intersection of creative and performance, spanning concepts, ad copy, hooks, and visual direction, with real ownership of creative KPIs, not just campaign KPIs
Proven experience acting as the creative bridge between performance marketing and creative or product teams, translating offers, product messaging, and campaign goals into platform-ready assets, and briefing designers, copywriters, and UX/UI colleagues with precise, performance-oriented creative briefs
Hands-on experience producing or closely directing assets for paid social (Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn) and video (YouTube, Reels, TikTok), including adapting technical specs to each platform and format
A strong visual and copy instinct, knowing what stops the scroll and what converts, paired with the ability to write sharp, conversion-driven ad copy from headlines and hooks to CTAs across formats and funnel stages, all backed by solid data analysis
Deep fluency in creative testing methodology, from A/B and multivariate testing to creative fatigue analysis and iteration cycles, along with the ability to read creative performance independently from overall campaign performance (ad strength, creative excellence scores, CTR, CVR) and turn that into actionable internal benchmarks
Audience and persona fluency, applying affinity groups, in market segments, and audience insights to creative decisions for each product line and campaign type
Comfortable managing Google Ads and Meta Ads end to end, including creative setup and optimisation
Fluent English and comfortable working in an international team

Should have:

Genuine enthusiasm for platform trends and continuous creative experimentation, combined with a collaborative communication style that keeps cross-functional stakeholders aligned
A data-driven mindset paired with genuine creative instinct, equally at home in a dashboard and in a brainstorm
Familiarity with affiliate partner creative requirements and specs

Nice to have:

Experience in B2B tech, SaaS, or the wider cloud and hosting industry
A portfolio or reel showcasing past creative work
German language skills or additional European languages, alongside fluent English

We know that you may not currently meet all the requirements. But if you come to us with the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm, we can take off together and make a big difference.

AWESOME PROSPECTS

At Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference.

What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint.

Additionally, we offer:

Work the way that fits your life – Remote or hybrid with flexible hours for a healthy work-life balance and the same technical equipment at home as in the office
Experience real freedom – Workation across the EU and in our summer office in Mallorca
Stay active and healthy – Access to EGYM Wellpass and thousands of fitness and wellness facilities
Enjoy exclusive perks – Attractive discounts on many products and services through our corporate benefits program
Recharge your energy – 30 days of vacation plus additional days off on Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve
Give back – An extra day off to get involved in social activities through our Volunteer Day
Make an impact – Take ownership and bring your ideas to life with real creative freedom
Keep growing – Individual professional and personal development opportunities in an innovative tech environment
Feel comfortable where you work – Modern, conveniently located offices across our European locations
Be part of a diverse team – Work in an international environment shaped by diversity
Create lasting memories – Company events and team activities you won’t forget

HOW TO REACH US

If you have any questions, you can reach out to Lisa by email at lisa.bretzel@contabo.de.

ABOUT US

Contabo - High-quality Cloud Hosting Made in Germany!

As a leading infrastructure service provider in the field of cloud instances and dedicated servers, we have stood for first-class quality, reliability and favorable prices since our foundation in Munich in 2003. Meanwhile, more than 300,000 customers in over 190 countries trust our services.

We specialize in providing German quality to users worldwide, focusing on the stability and security of our data centers, the optimization of internal processes, and excellent customer support.

Become a part of our future-oriented company, which plays a significant role in the development of digital cloud hosting, and support us with your ideas and commitment.

jobs.title: Creative Strategist (Video & Static Ads) - Romania
jobs.description:
Come and join the fastest growing Google Ads agency in the world, and own AI ad creative for YouTube from the first angle to the finished asset.

About Us:

Adcubator is the fastest growing Google Ads agency in the world. Led by our founder and CEO, Jem, we manage nine figures in annual ad spend across 180+ ecommerce DTC brands, powered by direct relationships with Google's product teams and access to alpha and beta features most agencies never touch. Our strategies are not public, our standards are high, and our results do the talking.

We grow fast because the work is that good, and we keep the team senior and selective on purpose. Our average client stays with us well beyond a year, close to unheard of in this industry. Join us and you plug into a team operating at the top of the game, and a founder whose personal brand is becoming the loudest signal in performance marketing.

The Role:

You own AI creative from the strategy down to the finished ad, with YouTube as the main focus, especially 16x9. That means the thinking and the making: research the market, define the avatars and personas, find the angles, then concept, script, generate, edit, and ship. We run across placements too, so you will build for other formats when the test calls for it, but YouTube is where you live. You build the formats bigger brands are scaling right now, AI VSLs, claymation, AI avatars, UGC hybrids, and the ones landing next month before they go mainstream.

This is a full ownership role. You are not handing an idea to a producer and waiting, and you are not waiting on a strategist to hand you a brief. You read the data, you decide the angle, you make the ad, and you iterate on what the numbers tell you. We test creative at volume and buy against real spend, so your work is live within days, not quarters. The best person for this treats creative as a testing problem, not an art project.

Requirements:

Proven experience concepting and producing ecommerce ad creative that ran on real spend, YouTube especially

You think in angles, avatars, and personas, and you can research a market before you touch a tool

Daily, fluent use of AI creative tools: Atria, Higgsfield, Claude, Manus, fal.ai, and whatever ships next. You already run these, we are not teaching them.

Comfortable reading performance data and letting it drive the next round of creative

Ability to own the full process solo, from research and strategy to finished asset

A real grasp of direct response, not just clean visuals

A testing mindset built on volume, variation, and reading what actually converts

Genuinely obsessed with new formats and models the week they drop

Responsibilities:

Research the market, the audience, and the competition to find angles worth testing

Define avatars and personas, and build creative concepts around them

Concept, script, generate, edit, and deliver AI ad creative end to end, with YouTube and 16x9 as the priority

Build for other placements and formats when a test calls for it

Build AI VSLs and the formats scaling right now: claymation, AI avatars, UGC hybrids, motion styles

Run a high volume creative testing pipeline, read the results honestly, and iterate on what wins

Stay ahead of every new tool and format in the space, and bring them in first

Feed winning creative into the media buying team and align with the content and landing page people so angle, page, and offer line up

What we offer:

Fully remote. Work from anywhere, with flexible hours.

A seat inside a premium agency managing nine figures in ad spend, making creative that runs on real budgets from day one.

A small, senior, global team with no bureaucracy and no busywork.

Paid time off.

A wellness bonus.

Team retreats and workations.

How to apply:

Submit your application through the form below. Include:
Your CV

Your portfolio

A short motivational letter: why this role, and why you

We can spot an AI written application instantly, and it goes straight in the bin. Show us how you actually think and work.

Good luck.
The Adcubator Team.

jobs.description:
Bhogi AI Inc (Contract, Remote – US based talent only)

Focus = Washington DC beltway area food app beta launch

TikTok & Instagram Marketing | DMV Region | Pre-launch: Aug 25 - Sep 25 Beta Launch: Sep 25- )ct 31, 2026

Most freelance marketing projects ask you to “grow our socials.” This isn’t one of them.

We’re launching a new AI-powered food identity app in a single market (DMV) over a focused beta period. Success won’t come from a big media budget — it will come from local insight, compelling storytelling, creator relationships, and smart execution.

If you’ve built your career on understanding one community deeply — not managing national content calendars — we’d love to hear from you.

About Bhogi

Bhogi helps people discover their taste — through personalized dish recommendations, food identity, and social dining experiences. Think of it as the app that finally understands what you actually want to eat, and connects you with others who eat the same way. There’s a distinctive social mechanic at the heart of the product that we’ll walk finalists through directly — it’s a key part of the content strategy, so we’re saving the details for later in the process.

We’re a small founding team (two senior engineers, a product lead, and an app developer) with no dedicated marketing person — so this role comes with real ownership and direct founder access.

The Role

We’re looking for a U.S.-based Creator Marketing Lead to shape and execute Bhogi’s TikTok and Instagram strategy from pre-launch through beta roll-out. This is a contract engagement, not a full-time hire — a tightly scoped project ideal for someone who moves fast, knows creator culture, and wants real creative ownership on a launch small enough to actually own end to end.

What You’ll Own

•	Creator strategy, hooks, and short-form content across TikTok and Instagram, pre-launch through beta

	•	Micro-creator identification, briefing, and deliverable management

	•	Weekly performance tracking and reporting, with fast iteration on what’s resonating

Deliverables by Phase

Pre-Launch (Aug 25–Sep 10)

	•	Strategy deck: platform approach, self-create vs. UGC, content pillars

	•	3–5 pieces of pre-launch content (teaser hooks, food-identity & quiz concepts) — used to test and validate which hooks/creators perform before beta opens

	•	Shortlist of 3–5 DMV micro-creators/food bloggers for beta partnerships

	•	Content calendar for Aug–Sep. Suggestions welcomed.

Beta Launch (Sep 10–30)

	•	Consistent posting cadence across TikTok and Instagram (~16 videos/posts over the 3-week window)

	•	Weekly performance summaries (engagement, reach, installs, activations, creator performance)

	•	Ongoing creative coordination and deliverable management

	•	End-of-beta report with learnings, recommendations, and growth insights

KPIs & Success Metrics

Acquisition: 750–1,000 beta app installs by Sep 30 · 500+ combined organic social followers

Activation: 60%+ of installs complete the food-identity quiz

Retention Signal: Positive early repeat engagement · 2–3 pieces of content at 10,000+ organic views

What We’re Looking For

	•	Proven experience running TikTok/Instagram creator campaigns with measurable results

	•	Strong instincts around food, lifestyle, consumer apps, or culture-driven brands

	•	Ability to create organic-style content that drives genuine curiosity and engagement

	•	Organized, fast-moving, and comfortable in early-stage startup environments

	•	U.S.-based required; DMV familiarity strongly preferred

Compensation & Timeline

	•	Fixed-fee, five-week engagement: $2,500

	•	The role combines hands-on short-form content creation with UGC creator recruitment and coordination

	•	We expect the successful candidate to personally create and edit some content while also recruiting and managing local creators

	•	Separate ~$500 budget reserved for amplifying content that’s already proven to perform during pre-launch — not spent blind

	•	Strong execution opens the door to continued engagement as Bhogi grows post-beta

How to Apply

Include in your proposal:

	1.	Three to five examples of short-form videos you personally filmed and edited

	2.	Whether those were your own productions or creator-coordinated content

	3.	Your honest read on whether the content volume and KPIs above are achievable in a 3-week beta — and what you’d change

We’ll follow up with a few screening questions. Thank you.

jobs.title: Creative Director (Art) en Hamlet 🎨
jobs.description:
Modalidad:
Híbrido

Localización:
Barcelona

Desde Candee
estamos gestionando esta posición de Creative Director (Art) para Hamlet.

¿Qué es Hamlet Strategic Makers?

Hamlet es una consultora estratégica y agencia creativa que trabaja desde el "business meets culture". Un equipo de optimistas obsesivos que combina estrategia, creatividad y ejecución para construir proyectos que realmente impacten en cómo hacemos las cosas. No son consultores, son Strategic Makers . La curiosidad guía todo lo que hacen.

¿Qué hace que Hamlet sea un sitio único?

Según nos ha contado el equipo de Hamlet, lo mejor de trabajar aquí es:

💥 Proyectos estratégicos de verdad, con marcas que confían y dejan espacio para construir algo que trasciende la campaña.
🧠 Cultura de confianza, criterio y ownership, donde se piensa antes de hacer y cada persona tiene un rol clave en el proceso.
🧩 El equilibrio perfecto entre talento top y calidad humana: cero postureo, mucho compañerismo y ganas reales de colaborar.

¿Cómo será tu equipo?

Trabajarás con un equipo creativo de 8 personas, en un entorno colaborativo, curioso y con mucha sensibilidad por las ideas, donde el intercambio de puntos de vista son parte del día a día.

Como Creative Director, tendrás un rol clave acompañando y guiando a otros perfiles creativos, asegurando que las ideas mantengan coherencia, calidad y ambición, con especial atención a su dirección visual y ejecución en todos los puntos de contacto.

¿Cuál será tu misión?

Tu misión será elevar el nivel creativo y visual de los proyectos de la agencia, asegurando que las ideas estratégicas se transformen en conceptos sólidos y universos visuales relevantes, reconocibles y muy bien ejecutados.

Serás una figura clave para garantizar la calidad y el craft creativo, la coherencia de los universos de marca y la correcta bajada visual de las ideas en todos los puntos de contacto.

Además, acompañarás al equipo creativo en el desarrollo de los proyectos, ayudando a que cada propuesta crezca desde el concepto hasta su expresión visual, cuidando especialmente la dirección de arte, el lenguaje gráfico y la consistencia de cada ejecución.

Entre tus responsabilidades estará:

La dirección creativa.
El liderazgo creativo y acompañamiento de equipos.
La conceptualización y dirección de arte de ideas, campañas, contenidos y experiencias de marca.
Construir, evolucionar y cuidar universos visuales de marca, definiendo códigos, lenguajes y criterios que permitan que las ideas vivan de forma coherente en distintos formatos y canales.
Supervisar el craft visual de las propuestas, asegurando un nivel de ejecución excelente desde las primeras exploraciones hasta las piezas finales.
Presentar, argumentar y elevar ideas con pasión.

¿Qué están buscando?

Buscamos un/a Creative Director con background en Art Direction y experiencia en agencia creativa, alguien con criterio creativo, una mirada visual excepcional y sensibilidad cultural, que se mueva con naturalidad entre ideas, campañas, branding y contenido digital.

En concreto, encajarás muy bien si:

Vienes del mundo de la publicidad o de agencias creativas, has desarrollado tu carrera desde la dirección de arte y trabajas en entornos donde la idea siempre manda.
Combinas pensamiento conceptual y estratégico con una mirada visual muy potente.
Tienes criterio para trabajar y dar dirección sobre distintas disciplinas visuales: diseño, fotografía, tipografía, motion, audiovisual y contenido digital, aunque no necesariamente ejecutes todas ellas.
Sabes construir y transmitir una visión visual: encontrar referencias, definir territorios estéticos y convertir una intuición creativa en una dirección clara para el equipo.
Disfrutas del big thinking, pero también de bajar al barro, explorar referencias, construir propuestas visuales y llevar una idea hasta una ejecución excelente.
Te obsesiona el craft y la presentación de las ideas, desde la construcción del concepto hasta el último detalle de la ejecución.
Tienes unos skills comunicativos brillantes, sabes argumentar y defender ideas y te mueves con seguridad en presentaciones ante cliente.
Tienes inglés fluido y catalán.
Buscas siempre la excelencia y tienes un estándar de calidad alto, cuidas el detalle y empujas las ideas para llevarlas un paso más allá.
Trabajas con ownership y autonomía, haciéndote responsable de los proyectos de principio a fin y actuando como si fueran tuyos.
Tienes agilidad mental para desenvolverte ante cambios, imprevistos o retos nuevos y encontrar rápidamente la mejor forma de avanzar.
Te mueves con ritmo y dinamismo, sabiendo priorizar, ejecutar con velocidad y organizarte de forma que también facilites el trabajo del resto del equipo.
Disfrutas trabajando de forma colaborativa, compartiendo criterio, dando feedback y ayudando a que el trabajo colectivo crezca.
Tienes curiosidad y proactividad de serie y te gusta cuestionr lo establecido, buscas nuevas referencias, exploras tendencias y aportas valor más allá de lo que estrictamente te toca.
Eres una persona ambiciosa que busca elevar el impacto del trabajo, detectar oportunidades y seguir creciendo profesionalmente.
Cuentas con un optimismo y entusiasmo que vienen de serie y afrontas los retos desde una actitud constructiva y orientada a soluciones.
Tienes una mirada cultural actualizada y una inquietud constante por entender qué está pasando fuera de tu propia disciplina.

¿Qué ofrecen?

🕐 Flexibilidad horaria.
🏡 Modelo híbrido, con reuniones presenciales periódicas en oficina en días marcados.
🌴 Vacaciones flexibles.
💬 Un entorno colaborativo maduro, con mucha interlocución directa.

¿Cómo será tu proceso de selección?

Aplica a la vacante.
Entrevista estructurada: Si cumples los requisitos, tu Talent Partner se pondrá en contacto contigo para que puedas resolver dudas sobre la posición y para empezar a conocerte más allá de tu CV.
Caso práctico: En caso de que ambas partes consideréis que hay encaje, te enviaremos un caso práctico para que podamos verte en acción👩🏻‍💻 y acordaremos una fecha contigo para que se lo puedas presentar online al equipo de Hamlet.
Entrevista con Hamlet: Si has bordado el caso, agendaremos una entrevista presenical con Hamlet para que os podáis conocer en persona y confirmar el encaje de la oportunidad por ambas partes.

Durante todo el proceso tendrás contacto directo con tu Talent Agent para poder resolver cualquier duda o inquietud.

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

You start your day partnering with business teams to uncover opportunities where AI can simplify work, improve productivity, and create measurable business value. As an AI Implementation Specialist, you will design, build, and deploy AI-powered solutions, agents, copilots, and automated workflows that help teams work smarter and more efficiently. Working closely with stakeholders across the organization, you will combine hands-on technical expertise with a strong consulting mindset to turn innovative ideas into scalable solutions. You will also champion AI adoption by helping colleagues understand what is possible and enabling them to realize the full potential of emerging technologies. Every day brings new opportunities to transform the way we work through practical and impactful AI innovation.

How You’ll Make an Impact

Identify, design, and implement AI use cases that improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, and deliver measurable productivity gains.
Build, deploy, and maintain AI agents, copilots, and automated workflows that support business objectives.
Drive AI adoption through training sessions, workshops, and hands-on coaching for business teams.
Ensure AI solutions comply with Siemens Energy standards, AI governance requirements, InfoSec guidelines, and release processes.
Develop scalable and reusable AI solutions while continuously introducing innovative capabilities and new ways of working.

What You Bring

Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Business Informatics, or a related field.
Hands-on experience with Generative AI, AI agents, workflow automation, and digital transformation initiatives.
Practical knowledge of Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Azure AI Services, OpenAI technologies, or similar platforms.
Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business needs into practical AI solutions.
Fluent English skills; experience with enterprise AI deployments, AI governance, cybersecurity, compliance requirements, and change management is considered an advantage.

About The Team

You will join a collaborative and forward-thinking environment focused on accelerating AI adoption and digital transformation across the organization. The team works closely with business functions to identify high-impact opportunities, implement innovative AI solutions, and empower employees to maximize the value of emerging technologies. Together, you will help shape the future of work by creating scalable, secure, and business-driven AI capabilities that drive efficiency and innovation across the company.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With over 100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world’s electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

At Siemens Energy, we celebrate diversity and inclusion and are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute their best work. We believe that different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds strengthen our teams and drive innovation.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Fair compensation for international work

Remote work permitted within the country

At dotdotdash, we are more than marketers; we are explorers, innovators and creators of what’s next. Our name, inspired by morse code — a simple yet revolutionary medium of communication — reflects the core of what we create: multisensory experiences that communicate brand messages people can see, touch, hear and interact with. We’re seeking to grow our team with individuals who share our passion for tangible creativity, our commitment to pushing boundaries, and our belief in the power of participatory experiences. At the heart of everything we do are the principles that guide how we create and collaborate: • Play. We embrace curiosity, experimentation and fun in our work and our partnerships. • Take Risks. Bring new ideas, new stories and new toys to the team to stay ahead of culture and write the future. ABOUT DOTDOTDASH As part of Omnicom Advertising Group, we combine boutique service and craft with the reach and resources of a global network. Our Pulse. dotdotdash is where creativity meets reality and ideas take tangible form. We are rooted in making and producing, combining emerging media and technology to take informed risks and create industry firsts. Whether crafting campaigns, digital products or transformative experiences, our joy and passion have always been at the interplay between thinking and doing, between imagining what’s possible and making it real. Our People. dotdotdash is a home for dreamers, makers, and disruptors who challenge the status quo and collaborate with curiosity and courage. Here, we don’t just make a living being creative; we live to create. We don’t just deliver work to satisfy scope, we create work that goes beyond, to shift perspectives and influence the future. jobs.description:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).


This posting is not tied to a current open role, but is an opportunity to join our talent pool for future positions. By applying, you’ll be considered as opportunities that align with your experience that become available.


The Role
We are makers. We create because we are curious, and we believe that the best way to prove an idea works is to make it real.
As an Associate Creative Director, you are the driving force of our creative execution. You sit at the critical intersection of visionary leadership and hands-on craft. You are stepping into the ranks of creative management, but your primary value is still rooted in your ability to make extraordinary things.


Your mandate is to take high-level strategic direction from your Creative Director and translate it into flawless, tangible executions that meet our uncompromising standard for iconic work—clear, human, and useful. You will own complex workstreams, mentor junior and mid-level creatives, and serve as the first line of defense for aesthetic and narrative quality. Furthermore, you will be the day-to-day champion of tech-enabled creativity, proving how the integration of AI tools can accelerate the journey from a blank page to a brilliant outcome.


Key Responsibilities
Craft Excellence & Execution

Translate Vision to Reality: Take the overarching creative vision and break it down into actionable sprints and deliverables. You own the execution phase, ensuring the integrity of the idea survives the production process.
The First Line of Defense: Provide rigorous, daily quality control over your workstream. You must sweat the details—typography, pacing, UI interactions, and narrative flow—ensuring nothing moves up to the CD or out to the client unless it meets our highest standard.

Shape the future of performance marketing at Puffy, where paid media is the primary growth lever.

What Is In It For You:

This isn't just another performance marketing role. This is your chance to become a true industry architect.

1. Own the Paid Engine End to End, With No Layers Above You

You set the strategy, build the systems, and own the outcomes.

You allocate multi-million-dollar monthly budgets across Google and Meta on marginal return rather than platform-reported averages, design the pause/hold/scale logic and budget guardrails that govern all paid spend, and serve as the single source of truth on paid media performance. Creative runs as a system you architect: concept pipeline, testing taxonomy, briefs, hook/hold analytics, UGC, whitelisting.

Social Heaven, part of trafficdesign | 100 % remote möglich, oder aus unseren Büros in Köln und Hamburg | Vollzeit | ab sofort

Aufgaben
#deinestelle 🚀

Über 800 Ads im Monat. Über 1000 vorqualifizierte Creator im Pool. Wir geben unseren Kunden ein Versprechen
, das wir halten müssen: UGC Ads in 18 Tagen, mit halbierten CPCs und vierfacher CTR.

Damit das funktioniert, braucht es jemanden, der vor der Produktion denkt. Genau das ist deine Rolle. Du übersetzt Produkt, Zielgruppe und Performance-Daten in Angles und Konzepte, suchst die Creator aus, die diese Angles glaubwürdig tragen, und begleitest das Ganze bis zum fertigen Ad. Du bist dabei nicht im Hinterzimmer: Du sprichst direkt mit den Brands, präsentierst deine Konzepte und verantwortest, was am Ende ausgeliefert wird.

#partoftrafficdesign🩵

Social Heaven ist Teil von trafficdesign
, einer der etablierten Online-Marketing-Agenturen in Köln und Hamburg mit über 70 Kolleg:innen.

Für dich heißt das: Du arbeitest in einem kleinen, schnellen, remote-first Team mit kurzen Wegen und viel Gestaltungsraum. Gleichzeitig hast du die Struktur einer großen Agentur im Rücken. Media Buyer, die dir sagen, wie deine Creatives wirklich performt haben. Analytics und Account Management, die du nicht selbst aufbauen musst. Zwei Büros, in die du kommen kannst, wenn du Lust auf Menschen hast. Weiterbildungsbudget, Coaching und ein Benefit-Paket, das du als kleine Content-Agentur sonst nicht bekommst. Und Karrierewege, die nicht an der Grenze einer Zehn-Personen-Firma enden.

Marke eigenständig, Ressourcen groß. Das ist der Deal 🤝

#deineaufgaben

🔥 Strategie & Angles:
Du gräbst dich in Produkt, Zielgruppe, Reviews und Wettbewerb ein und entwickelst daraus Angles, die den Nerv treffen. Pro Brand, pro Funnel-Stufe, pro Plattform.

🔥 Konzeption & Scripting:
Du schreibst Konzepte, Hooks und Skripte für UGC Ads, Street Interviews und Advertorials. So klar, dass ein Creator sie ohne Rückfragen umsetzen kann, so offen, dass die Persönlichkeit erhalten bleibt.

🔥 Creator-Auswahl:
Du wählst aus unserem Pool die Creator aus, die zur Marke, zur Zielgruppe und zum Angle passen. Typ, Sprache, Branche, Glaubwürdigkeit, alles muss stimmen. Wenn niemand passt, sourct ihr gezielt nach.

🔥 Briefing & Begleitung:
Du briefst Creator, beantwortest Rückfragen, gibst Feedback auf Rohmaterial und steuerst Nachdrehs, wenn etwas nicht sitzt.

🔥 Qualitätssicherung:
Du sichtest, was reinkommt, und entscheidest, was rausgeht. Markenfit, Aussage, Compliance, Schnittfassung. Was dein Okay hat, geht zur Kundin.

🔥 Kundenkommunikation:
Du bist für deine Brands die Ansprechperson für alles Kreative. Du präsentierst Konzepte, holst Feedback ein und ordnest es ein, steuerst Freigaben und Abstimmungsschleifen und sagst auch mal begründet Nein. Aus Ergebnissen und Kundenzielen leitest du die nächste Welle ab.

🔥 Creative Data:
Du schaust dir an, welche Hooks, Creator und Formate performt haben, und nimmst die Learnings in das nächste Konzept mit. Testing-Logik statt Bauchgefühl.

Qualifikation
#wasdumitbringst

🤝 Erfahrung in Creative Strategy, UGC, Social Advertising oder Content-Konzeption, gerne aus Agentur, DTC-Brand oder Creator-Umfeld

🤝 Du weißt, was eine Ad verkauft und was nur schön ist. Hook Rate, Hold Rate, CTR und CPA sind für dich Arbeitsmaterial, nicht Reporting-Deko

🤝 Du kannst schreiben: Hooks, Skripte, Briefings, auf den Punkt und in der Sprache der Zielgruppe

🤝 Ein gutes Auge für Menschen: du erkennst, welcher Creator eine Botschaft glaubwürdig trägt

🤝 Sicheres Auftreten gegenüber Kund:innen, auch wenn Feedback mal unbequem ist

🤝 Struktur und Eigenverantwortung, gerade im Remote-Setup

🤝 Perfektes Deutsch und gutes Englisch

🤝 Du findest dich in unseren Werten wieder: Kundenbegeisterung, Authentizität, Qualitätsversprechen, Zuverlässigkeit und ein freundschaftliches Miteinander

Workation möglich 🏝️ (und zwar nicht nur auf dem Papier)

The position combines strategic leadership with hands-on copywriting, particularly across landing pages, lifecycle email, product messaging, and PR communications.

You will connect content performance to measurable business outcomes, including organic acquisition, conversions, signups, and customer acquisition cost.

A major focus will be translating complex crypto and tax concepts into clear, trustworthy, high-converting experiences for users.

You will operate with significant autonomy, empowering a distributed team while continuously improving workflows, content quality, and channel performance.

This is an opportunity to shape the narrative of a growing product while building a scalable, data-informed content operation.

Lead the overall content strategy and operating model across written content, SEO, video, social, technical writing, and related channels.
Manage and mentor channel specialists, setting clear objectives and KPIs, providing feedback, removing blockers, and supporting professional development.
