jobs.title: Creative Director (FCMG, food & lifestyle)
jobs.description:
Location: Barcelona

About us

We are Dragons, a global creative agency working with bold brands to build cultural relevance, connection, and long-term impact through strategy-led creativity.

We bridge digital and creative thinking, developing innovative work across skincare, healthcare, fashion, lifestyle, FMCG, and more. Our international teams in the US and Barcelona deliver results through smart strategy, sharp creativity, and meticulous execution.

About the Role

We're looking for a Creative Director with strong ideas, great visual taste and a real understanding of Spanish culture and consumers, combined with solid international experience.

This person will work primarily across brands and projects with a strong focus on the Spanish market, spanning food, lifestyle, FMCG and other consumer categories.

We're looking for someone who understands the Spanish market deeply, but has also worked with international brands, teams and clients, bringing a broader creative perspective to the work.

As Creative Director, you'll lead creative development across brands, from campaign platforms and launches to social, activations, partnerships, content and brand experiences.

The work can vary significantly from brief to brief. One project might require a big emotional campaign for a household brand. Another might be a food or lifestyle launch that needs to feel desirable and contemporary. Another might start with a global platform that requires a strong local expression rather than simply a translated headline.

You'll work closely with Strategy, Copy, Art Direction, Social and Production teams to develop work that is culturally relevant, visually strong and commercially effective.

Key Responsibilities

Develop strong campaign ideas and creative platforms for Spanish and international consumer brands.

Partner closely with Strategy to understand audiences, behaviors and cultural insights, and turn them into creative opportunities.

Develop original campaigns for the Spanish market, as well as local expressions of global brand platforms.

Understand the nuances of Spanish culture, humor, language and consumer behavior without relying on obvious cultural clichés.

Bring experience from international brands and markets into the work while ensuring ideas remain relevant to local audiences.

Develop ideas across film, social, OOH, digital, retail, experiential, PR, partnerships and content.

Understand how creative should work across different stages of the funnel and across different channels.

Recognize when a brief needs a big campaign idea and when the stronger solution may be an activation, collaboration, creator partnership, product experience or social-first idea.

Create work around products that feels desirable and contemporary, particularly within food, lifestyle and FMCG categories.

Develop culturally relevant ideas around talent, creators, entertainment and partnerships.

Lead campaigns from concept through production, protecting both the idea and the quality of execution.

Direct photography, film, casting, styling and external creative partners when required.

Present and sell creative work confidently to clients.

Lead, inspire and develop multidisciplinary creative teams.

Key Requirements

Creative Leadership & Strategic Thinking

Strong conceptual thinking and creative problem-solving skills.

Ability to identify the bigger creative opportunity behind a brief and transform it into a compelling campaign platform, not just an execution.

Experience leading multidisciplinary creative teams and collaborating closely with strategists.

Spanish Market Expertise

Strong understanding of the Spanish market, its consumers, language, humor and cultural nuances.

Ability to develop authentic, culturally relevant work that resonates locally.

International Perspective

Experience working with global brands, international clients or multicultural teams.

Ability to bring a broader perspective and strong creative standards while ensuring ideas remain locally relevant.

Strong understanding of when a global idea can translate naturally, when it needs adaptation and when a market requires a locally originated solution.

Visual & Creative Excellence

Contemporary visual taste with a strong eye for photography, film, casting, styling, design and the visual language of modern consumer brands.

Ability to balance product storytelling with brand-building, creating work that is both commercially effective and culturally engaging.

Understanding of how brands can participate in culture through talent, creators, partnerships, experiences and social channels.

Experience

10+ years of creative experience, ideally within agencies and/or consumer brands.

Experience as a Creative Director or senior creative leader.

Proven experience developing integrated campaigns from concept through production.

Experience across food & beverage, FMCG, lifestyle, beauty, entertainment or other consumer categories is highly valued.

Strong knowledge of the Spanish market and culture.

Meaningful experience working with international brands, teams or clients.

Portfolio demonstrating strong conceptual work combined with a contemporary visual perspective.

Experience across brand campaigns, social, activations, partnerships and culturally relevant work.

Strong client-facing, communication and presentation skills.

Native or near-native Spanish.

Strong professional English, with sufficient fluency to concept, collaborate and present comfortably in English.

Portfolio

We want to see ideas, taste and range.

Showcase strong campaigns, as well as activations, social ideas, collaborations and product experiences that demonstrate different ways brands can connect with people.

We want to see work that feels relevant to its audience, where the product matters and the visual execution is strong.

Most importantly, your portfolio should demonstrate both sides of the profile: a genuine understanding of the Spanish market and meaningful experience working internationally.

Languages

English (mandatory)

Spanish (mandatory)

Any other languages are a plus.

What we offer

Remote flex Fridays from 9:00 AM to 2.30 PM.

Three weeks of remote work per year.

Summer working hours across July and August (9:00 AM to 4.00 PM).

Free English & Spanish classes to boost your global communication skills.

Access to Wellhub, a wellness platform offering a wide range of fitness and wellbeing options.

Flexible retribution plan for meals, transport and childcare.

Holidays: 22 working days + 3 days established by the collective agreement + national and local public holidays.

Bright, spacious offices in the heart of Barcelona.

Competitive salary with real growth opportunities.

A global environment, cutting-edge tools, and a culture driven by trends and innovation.

At Dragons Group, we are dedicated to creating a workplace that values diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and strive to build an environment where every individual feels empowered and respected.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Labhouse is a fast-growing startup that builds, launches, and scales its own AI & Productivity Apps, operating under a subscription-based business model.
Based in Barcelona, Labhouse was founded by Andrés Bou and Horacio Martos (Co-Founders of SocialPoint).
We operate at the intersection of mobile technology, AI, and product-driven growth, with a strong focus on experimentation and performance.
Would you like to make an impact as part of a company that builds the best mobile apps used by millions of users worldwide? If so, discover your next challenge below.

About the Role:

At Labhouse we're looking to bring into our Growth team someone who has deep mastery of one acquisition channel
and can prove it with real numbers: how much they invested, over what period, and what growth that investment drove.
We're not looking for a generalist who "touches a bit of everything." We're looking for specialists — in Apple Search Ads (ASA), Google (Ads Search, Display, Programmatic), Meta, AppLovin, YouTube, Unity, TikTok, UGC, or Influencer Marketing — who have pushed a channel to its maximum performance and can talk about concrete results, not theory.
If your strength is one channel and you know it better than anyone, this role is for you.

Responsibilities:

Manage and scale investment in your channel of expertise, with direct ownership over budget and results.
Define and execute the acquisition strategy for that channel: segmentation, creatives, testing, bid and budget optimization.
Report on performance rigorously (CAC, ROAS, LTV, incrementality) and make data-driven decisions.
Collaborate with Product, Creative, and Data to continuously improve channel performance.
Identify opportunities to expand into adjacent channels when the business needs it, without losing focus on your core area of expertise.

About You:

Academic background:

Degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Economics, Statistics, or a related field. Equivalent hands-on experience is equally valued.

Technical expertise:

Demonstrable experience managing your own budget in one
of these channels: Apple Search Ads (ASA), Google Ads Search, Google Display, Programmatic Marketing, Meta, AppLovin, YouTube, Unity Ads, TikTok, UGC, or Influencer Marketing.
Ability to show, with concrete data, how much you invested and what growth that investment produced (figures, timeframes, results — not just "I managed campaigns on X").
Hands-on experience with the tracking, attribution, and analytics stack tied to your channel (e.g. MMPs, GA4, ad platform dashboards, BI tools).

Problem-solving and product focus:

Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to resolve complex technical challenges.
Eye for detail and a product-first mindset, with a passion for creating exceptional user experiences.
Self-driven, entrepreneurial attitude with the ability to work autonomously and take ownership of projects.

Communication:

Excellent level of spoken and written English, Spanish is a plus.
Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including engineering, product, and marketing.

Nice to Have:

Pluses that are needed occasionally:
Experience in a second acquisition channel beyond your main one.
Background in digital product / apps / e-commerce environments with a growth focus.
Familiarity with creative testing and UGC/influencer content production

What we Offer:

Remote work from anywhere in Spain. If you are based in Barcelona, we would love for you to join us at the office (Barcelona Tech City) at least two days a week.
Flexible working hours.
High-end equipment for your development.
Permanent contract with competitive compensation.
A young and top entrepreneurial team in a dynamic startup environment.
Opportunity to lead, grow, and take on big challenges.
Work with cutting-edge technologies, including the chance to integrate AI models into new apps.

Hiring Process

TA Interview
– Initial conversation to get to know each other and understand your background.
CEO / Marketing Team Interview
– Deep dive into your Marketing & Product thinking, experience, and fit with the team.
Technical Case
– Practical exercise to assess your capabilities.
Final Interview
– Final conversation to ensure alignment on expectations, culture, and role fit.

You should Know:

Labhouse is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. However you identify or whatever your journey to this point, we welcome all candidates to apply for the position that inspires them.
Come join us and help us build a company that everyone is proud to be part of.

in Berlin. Wir kreieren hochwertige digitale Produkte und Marken, deren Designs sich durch Schlichtheit und Innovation ausdrücken. Wir sind keine Fließband-Agentur; wir sind Digitalstrateg:innen, die Marken für die Märkte der Zukunft transformieren.

.

Als Design Director bei LAUDO bist du Hüter:in unserer kreativen Vision. Du bist verantwortlich für die Qualität jedes einzelnen Projekts, das unsere Agentur verlässt, und stellst sicher, dass unsere Arbeit strategisch überzeugt.

jobs.title: AI Creative Lead
jobs.description: Forbes Advisor is hiring an AI Creative Lead to own the generative stack that turns approved scripts and storyboards into finished, on-brand video and static ads. This person is two things at once: a creative with a deep understanding of direct-response marketing, and a hands-on operator who lives in the AI tools daily. You run the back half of our pipeline, from character-locked stills through AI video, lip-sync, and voiceover to editor-ready footage, and you treat every step as a creative call as much as a technical one: what serves the story, what sells, and what will read as a real ad in the feed. The role reports into the Head of Creative Production and partners with our Creative Directors and Editor/Designers. You know what makes a DR ad work, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, and you know which model(s) to use and why. You can hold character, wardrobe, and continuity across a whole spot, debug a broken render instead of re-rolling, and get renders through touchy platform filters. You have shipped AI-generated video that ran as paid creative, and you can tell real-ad output from output that just reads as AI. We are a human-led shop that uses AI to move faster without diluting craft. You protect the craft bar rather than lowering it to what the model makes easy, and you stay current with a stack that turns over frequently, treating every tool pick as a short-term decision. RESPONSIBILITIES Own generation end-to-end for paid social and native creative: character-locked stills, AI video, lip-sync, and clean generated voiceover, from approved script and storyboard to editor-ready footage. Lock base characters first, then build a still per beat that references them, holding character, wardrobe, prop, and continuity consistency across an entire spot. Pick the right model for each job (hero vs. volume, native-audio vs. img-to-video) and keep a live view of a fast-moving tool stack, pinning exact model versions at build time. Scout, test, and onboard new models and tools as the stack evolves, and retire the ones that fall behind, so the team is always working with the best available. Get renders through platform and category filters. Diagnose and auto-fix a broken render once, then escalate, and keep a running swipe of safe phrasings and prompt patterns that pass. Operate and lightly orchestrate the tooling (fan-out, scheduling, asset movement) so many jobs run in parallel without a person babysitting each one. Own the generative-side handoff into post: deliver organized, tagged, editor-ready clips into the DAM to the production team's standards. Feed the shared learnings file (format, copy, render, and legal notes per job) and read it back at the next job's start so the system compounds instead of repeating mistakes. Partner with the Creative Directors and copywriters to keep generated output on-voice, on-persona, and matched beat-for-beat to the script (AV sync). Bring a direct-response creative eye to every job: push each render toward what sells, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, not just what looks good. Operate inside compliance rails for our regulated categories: no better-drug or results claims, coverage/qualify framing, required disclosures, and honest routing. Hold generation to the same gate as the rest of the pipeline. Manage generative tooling spend against render volume, and give the Head of Creative Production a real monthly cost model as volume scales. Build reusable assets (prompt libraries, character references, templates, and workflow docs) that let editors and strategists self-serve the routine work. REQUIREMENTS 4+ years in creative production, motion, VFX, or content, with at least the last 1 to 2 years hands-on in generative AI video and image production for real deliverables. A real grounding in direct-response creative. You understand how a DR ad is built (hook, problem, mechanism, proof, offer, and CTA) and can judge whether a cut will convert, not only whether it looks polished. Demonstrated generative craft: a reel or portfolio of AI-generated or AI-assisted video and stills, with an honest account of what you made vs. what the model made, and (ideally) how it performed. Deep, current fluency with the generative stack: multi-subject-consistency image models, AI video (native-audio and img-to-video), lip-sync, and AI voiceover. You have opinions on trade-offs, not just tool names. Character and continuity discipline: you can hold a consistent character across many shots and beats, not just generate one good frame. Prompt and troubleshooting fluency: you can diagnose why a render broke or a character drifted and fix it deliberately, rather than re-rolling until something lands. Comfort building light automation/orchestration around the tools (e.g. n8n, Gumloop, or comparable) to fan out and move assets. You don't need to be an engineer, but you're not afraid of the glue. A finishing eye: you know when AI output reads as a real ad vs. a tech demo, and you hold the line on craft. Demonstrated speed and volume in a performance, DR, or high-output content environment. Comfortable shipping many cuts and variants a week across multiple categories. Comfort working inside compliance rails (regulated-category claims, platform ad policy, partner brand guardrails). Strong collaboration across Creative, Production, Post, and Buying, and clear written communication for briefs, prompt docs, and learnings. Self-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset, comfortable in a start-up style operating environment where the tools change under you. STRONG PLUSES Generative video that has run as paid social or DR creative with attributable performance, not only brand or experimental work. Concepting or copywriting experience on DR ads, so you can improve a script or angle, not just execute it. Direct experience generating for regulated DR categories and getting their renders through platform filters. Video editing or motion/VFX background

Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/



About the roleWe are looking for a superhero-level Lead Ad Creative Producer to lead and control the entire creative production operation at one of Ruby Labs’ fastest-growing consumer products.

This is a producing lead (player-coach) role. You produce winning ad creatives with your own hands and you run the production operation. This role is not about writing briefs and coordinating — it is about conversion, control, standards, and consistency at scale, with your own creatives setting the bar for the team.

You will own the creative production process end-to-end: how creatives are ideated, designed, reviewed, refined, approved, and delivered. You are accountable for winning creatives, creative quality, execution speed, compliance, and production discipline. You will work directly with User Acquisition Managers and manage a team of a creative producer and designers, acting as the final creative quality and compliance guard before any asset reaches testing or traffic.



Core MissionDeliver a reliable stream of winning ad creatives by concentrating production volume on proven winning angles, while running a disciplined, fully traceable, compliant production operation — from ideation to launch.

Brand and visual standards

Pixel perfect design

Performance-oriented execution

Clear

jobs.title: Sr. Creative Designer (Performance Marketing) - Static & Motion
jobs.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken's Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, static and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships.

The opportunity

As our Senior Performance Creative, you concept, produce and ship paid creative for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Paid static is the center of the role,
but we're hiring a hybrid rather than a specialist: this means you also ideate and create performance video and treat gen AI as a core production method rather than a novelty. You take a project from idea to a finished, approved, multi-market asset set, and you bring a real feel for what people stop on, share and screenshot.

You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. Senior here means craft and automation leadership: you set the bar for paid static on the team, work with AI enabled processes, collaborate closely with other Krakenites in and outside the team, and are the person others come to with performance creative questions.

Own paid static for Kraken Consumer across product launches, campaigns, promotions and always-on activity.
Build for channels like Meta, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit and X. You know what wins where, and you build to each platform's specs and native feel.
Concept and cut performance video so campaigns ship as complete cross-format sets, from 9:16 sound-on to static-adjacent 1:1 and 4:5.
Produce AI-generated and AI-assisted video and imagery, and know when AI is the fastest route to a great ad and when it isn't.
Bring ideas to briefs rather than executing them literally. Pitch culturally timely, internet-native concepts that nobody asked for, and build the winners into creative pillars we can keep using.
Version and localize at scale across markets, languages, formats and regulatory requirements. In a typical month you'll have roughly a dozen workstreams in flight at once, most spanning several formats and several markets.
Build creative that's designed to be tested. Performance Marketing owns test design, cadence and readouts. You own the creative response: reading the results, forming a point of view on why a variant won, and turning that into the next round of hooks, concepts and cuts.
Partner with Product Marketing, compliance and regional teams to get work approved without losing the idea.
Hold a high craft bar on your own work and keep your files clean enough for other people to build on.

What You’ll Bring

5+ years in performance creative at a high-volume in-house team or performance agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category.
A portfolio that proves it, submitted with your application. Paid static above all, with the brief or objective alongside the work and the result where you're able to share it. Include two or three full video cuts, at least one AI-generated or AI-assisted piece with a short note on what was tooling and what was you, and one concept you tested where you can talk us through what the data said and what you changed.
Layout, hierarchy, type and composition that hold up at thumbnail size, in feed, and in multiple languages.
Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok and YouTube. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one.
Real video skills, from concept to finished, sound-designed cut.
High-level command of gen AI video and image tooling, with shipped work to show for it.
Experience inside a structured creative testing program. You're fluent in the metrics your creative moves (thumb-stop rate, hook rate, CTR, CVR, CPA and ROAS), you can tell a real winner from low performers, and can translate test results into a creative decision.
Fluency in internet and meme culture, with comedic timing and an instinct for what's about to feel dated.
Speed without sloppiness. Comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes.
Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with layouts that survive risk warnings and market-specific requirements.
A solid copywriting instinct. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon.
Figma and Adobe CC (After Effects, Premiere, Photoshop) as well as strong genAI skills
Curious about investing and crypto at a minimum, and able to make the space legible to others.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Visual AI Creative Lead
jobs.description:
Join the Team Building the Future of AI-Powered Visual Creativity

For photographers, visual storytellers, art directors, and creative minds shaping the future of AI.



Aurify LLC — part of a global technology community with 60+ million followers worldwide — is looking for exceptional creative minds to help redefine how people create, transform, and experience photography with artificial intelligence.



We're not building another image generator. We're building a technology that understands why images matter — the emotion, meaning, composition, and creative decisions behind a photograph — so that millions of people can become part of extraordinary visual experiences.



This is not a traditional design role. This is a chance to help build the future of photography in the age of AI.



About The Project: Character Transfer

Unlike traditional face-swap technology, we're not just replacing one face with another.



We're building a system that understands the complete visual story of an image — why a moment feels special, what emotion it communicates, what makes the composition powerful, and what must stay unchanged for the image to keep its meaning.



The goal: when a new person enters an existing scene, it should feel as if they were truly there when the photograph was taken.



Not inserted. Not copied. Belonging.



Who We're Looking For

We need a rare combination of creative intelligence and technical curiosity — someone who sees beyond pixels and can read the emotional core, hidden story, and creative intention behind a photograph.



You may come from photography, filmmaking, advertising, fashion, VFX, digital production, or creative technology. Your background matters less than your ability to understand visual language.



Your Mission

You'll help build the intelligence behind our Character Transfer Engine, focused on three areas.



1. Teaching AI to Understand Visual Stories




Every photograph has creative DNA.
For each template, you'll define:
the story being told
its emotional purpose
the relationship between people and environment
visual hierarchy
what must be preserved
what can adapt


Example




A romantic image isn't just "two people looking at each other" — its true value is connection, anticipation, vulnerability, intimacy, trust.
A travel image isn't just "someone near a landmark" — it's discovery, freedom, adventure, achievement, memory.
AI has to understand that difference.


2. Designing Scalable AI Creative Systems

We're not looking for someone who manually perfects one beautiful image — anyone can do that.



We need people who can help build a system that delivers consistently excellent results across:

thousands of templates




millions of users
every age
every appearance
every body type
every culture
every photography condition


You'll contribute to:




AI workflow design
creative instructions
prompt architecture
transformation logic
quality standards
edge-case analysis
evaluation frameworks


3. Evaluating AI Results Through a Creative Lens

You'll help define what high quality really means by evaluating whether results preserve:




Identity — does the person still feel authentic?
Story — do they naturally belong in the scene?
Emotion — does their expression and body language match the moment?
Physical Reality — lighting, shadows, perspective, camera characteristics, skin texture, anatomy, natural imperfections
Artistic Value — does this look like a real moment that actually happened?


Ideal Background (One or More)

Photography & Visual Storytelling

Professional, commercial, or fashion photographers, photo editors, creative/art directors, cinematographers who understand composition, lighting, emotion, directing people, and visual communication.



Advertising, Fashion & Brand Creative

Experience with advertising campaigns, fashion or luxury brands, creative studios, or commercial productions.

You know great images don't just look beautiful — they communicate ideas.



VFX & Digital Production

Compositing, CGI, motion design, digital production pipelines.

Especially valuable: experience maintaining visual quality across large-scale production.



AI Creative Technology

AI image generation/editing workflows, multimodal AI systems, diffusion models, ComfyUI workflows, advanced prompting, creative automation.

The strongest candidates think in multiple dimensions at once.
A photographer asks: "Why does this image create emotion?"
A filmmaker asks: "What story is happening in this moment?"
An art director asks: "What should the audience feel?"
A technologist asks: "How can we make this repeatable at scale?"
The ideal person combines all four.


Who This Role Isn't For

This isn't for someone who only creates attractive AI images or experiments with prompts, or who optimizes a single result manually.



We're looking for people who understand creativity, build systems, and help AI learn the principles behind great photography.



Hiring Challenge

Candidates may be asked to analyze a collection of original photo templates and explain:




what makes each image emotionally powerful
the core story of the image
which elements must be preserved vs. adapted
how to design a system capable of maintaining quality across 500+ different people
The goal isn't one impressive image — it's designing the thinking behind thousands of successful ones.


Why Join Aurify

Your work will be experienced by a global audience of 60+ million people, shaping how they create, share, and experience visual memories.



Most AI tools today generate images from text.



We're building something fundamentally different:



A system that understands existing human creativity and lets anyone become part of meaningful visual stories.



You'll help define how AI understands:




human emotion
visual storytelling

Creators who successfully complete the paid trial may be offered an ongoing contract.

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Manager (f/m/d) Paid Social
jobs.description:
OUR PURPOSE AT PLANCRAFT

Building the backbone of European trades – together, with modern software and smart AI solutions.

We don’t just develop software – we’re on a mission to give tradespeople and contractors more room to focus on what matters. We do this by providing a practical SaaS solution that works the way they do: fast, efficient, and without unnecessary administrative overhead. Supported by smart AI features exactly where they make a real difference in everyday work.

Backed by Tier 1 investors from Europe and the US such as Headline and Creandum, and with more than 30,000 craftspeople as our customer base, we are scaling across Europe to turn individual, scattered businesses into connected and successful communities.

We believe in zero admin, not zero personality – and we build every feature with the people wearing safety boots in mind, not suits. We’re excited to shape the future together as a team, staying grounded in our mission to empower the builders and makers of tomorrow.

YOUR MISSION AT PLANCRAFT

As a Performance Marketing Manager (f/m/d)
at plancraft, you take ownership of Paid Social channels (e.g. Paid Social, Paid Search, or Programmatic) and drive its performance end-to-end. You execute, analyse, and continuously optimise campaigns based on data, while identifying scalable growth opportunities within your domain. You contribute to a high-performing marketing setup by bringing deep channel expertise and translating insights into clear, actionable improvements.

Your Responsibilities

Own the performance of Paid Social channels end-to-end — from setup and execution to optimisation and reporting
Plan, launch, and continuously optimise campaigns based on clear KPIs (e.g. CPA, ROAS, pipeline impact)
Analyse campaign performance and translate data into actionable insights to improve results
Run structured experiments (A/B tests) and scale successful approaches within your channel
Collaborate closely with Brand, Content, and RevOps to improve creatives, messaging, and funnel performance
Support the development of tracking, attribution, and reporting setups to enable reliable decision-making
Identify and test new opportunities within your channel to unlock additional growth
Stay up to date with platform developments, trends, and automation or AI-driven improvements

YOUR PROFILE

Must-haves:

2–3+ years of hands-on experience in performance marketing in a data-driven environment
Deep expertise in the main Paid Social channels (e.g. Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn), ideally gained within a larger performance marketing team
Proven experience owning and optimising campaigns within your channel with clear performance impact
Strong analytical skills and ability to derive actionable insights from data
Experience with common tracking and analytics tools (e.g. GA4, Google Tag Manager or similar)
Experience running structured tests and applying data-driven optimisation approaches
Solid understanding of performance metrics across the funnel
Structured, proactive, and solution-oriented working style
Strong ownership mindset and ability to work independently within your scope
Strong communication skills in English (C1/C2 level)

Nice-to-haves:

Experience in SaaS or B2B tech environments
Exposure to additional paid channels beyond social
Experience with attribution models or more complex tracking setups
Experience supporting international campaign scaling
Interest in applying AI tools to improve campaign performance and efficiency

WHY PLANCRAFT?

Team Spirit: We’re driven by passion, commitment, and a shared mission. Team spirit matters to us — and we make it visible: with four major team event weeks per year, casual monthly on-site and remote formats, and a strong recognition culture where we regularly celebrate both the big and small wins together.
Ownership: You’re encouraged to take ownership from day one. In a flat hierarchy and high-trust environment, you’re empowered to make meaningful decisions and drive real impact.
Learning & Growth: We invest in your personal and professional development through a strong feedback culture, a personal learning budget, and targeted enablement formats. Our goal is to help you unlock your full potential.
AI Enablement: Our internal tools and workflows are AI-enabled by design. We support every team and individual in applying AI at the next level in their daily work, including getting your own ChatGPT+ license, of course.
Tech & Tooling: You’ll receive a MacBook, premium headphones, and everything else you need — from hardware to tools — to be effective in your daily doing.
Flexibility: Whether Hybrid, or on-site — you work where you’re at your best. Our Hamburg office at Rödingsmarkt (with a rooftop terrace) is always open, and you decide each week how often you come in. And if you need a change of scenery, working abroad worldwide up to 2 months is always an option.
Recharge: To ensure the needed rest, we offer 30 vacation days per year (based on a 5-day week) plus Dec 24th off. We also subsidize your Urban Sports Club membership and organize internal sport meetups.
Mobility: You can lease a "JobRad" (Bike) and get a subsidized "Deutschlandticket" or "BahnCard" for public transport to be supported in your commute.
International Environment: We’re becoming more international every month, with team members already in Italy, France, the Netherlands, and Austria — which is why English is our internal company language.

jobs.title: Production Director – Seasonal Content | MONOPOLY GO!
jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Production Director – Seasonal Content to join our MONOPOLY GO! team. This role can be based remotely in the UK or from our Barcelona hub on a hybrid basis.

MONOPOLY GO! is a global phenomenon and the biggest mobile game launch in history, captivating millions of players worldwide.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and strive to inspire play every day—whether through our work alongside exceptional teammates or through unforgettable experiences for millions of players. We're a global team of game makers building one of the world's most successful live-service games.

As the Production Director – Seasonal Content, you'll own the operational health, planning, and execution behind MONOPOLY GO!'s seasonal content portfolio. You'll partner across Art, Design, Product, Live Operations, Licensing, and Content teams to ensure every season delivers exceptional quality, creative novelty, operational excellence, and measurable player impact.

Success in this role goes beyond shipping content on schedule. You'll be accountable for the health of the seasonal ecosystem—including content capacity, creative ambition, production predictability, IP integration, execution quality, and the cross-functional alignment required to consistently deliver industry-leading live-service seasons.

This role requires an exceptional balance of strategic leadership and tactical execution. You'll be equally comfortable shaping long-term organizational strategy with senior leadership as you are rolling up your sleeves with producers, artists, designers, and engineers to solve production challenges, unblock teams, and improve execution day-to-day.

What You'll Do

Lead production for the Seasonal Content organization, overseeing the planning, execution, and successful delivery of every MONOPOLY GO! season.
Own the operational health of the seasonal portfolio, balancing player experience, content quality, novelty, production predictability, resource utilization, and business objectives—not simply delivery against schedule.
Drive the long-term evolution of the seasonal content pipeline, continuously improving how art, design, narrative, gameplay content, rewards, licensed IP, localization, and live operations move from concept through launch.
Own content roadmap planning, art capacity planning, outsourcing strategy, and resource forecasting to maximize both creative ambition and sustainable execution.
Partner closely with Product, Art, Design, Live Operations, Marketing, and Licensing leadership to align priorities across multiple concurrent seasonal initiatives.
Operate comfortably at both the executive and production floor levels—providing strategic direction while remaining actively involved in milestone reviews, dependency management, issue resolution, production planning, and critical decision making.
Be willing to get "in the weeds" with producers and development teams to remove blockers, resolve ambiguity, improve workflows, and ensure teams have what they need to succeed.
Lead cross-functional planning for major seasonal launches, proactively identifying execution risks, staffing challenges, dependency conflicts, and operational gaps before they impact delivery.
Drive executive-level visibility through clear reporting, production health metrics, risk assessments, and actionable recommendations.
Champion continuous improvement across production methodologies, governance, tooling, AI adoption, and content development workflows.
Lead organizational change initiatives that improve how teams plan, collaborate, and execute, ensuring new processes are successfully adopted across multiple disciplines.
Serve as a diplomatic leader who builds trust across diverse teams, navigates competing priorities with empathy, and facilitates alignment during high-pressure or ambiguous situations.
Mentor Production Managers and Producers while raising the overall maturity and effectiveness of production across the Seasonal Content organization.

What We're Looking For

Extensive experience leading production within large-scale live-service game development environments.
Deep expertise managing content-heavy production pipelines, including art production, outsourcing, IP development, localization, approvals, and live seasonal releases.
Demonstrated success operating as a Production Director or equivalent leader responsible for both organizational strategy and execution.
Proven ability to seamlessly shift between strategic leadership and hands-on production management, remaining deeply connected to execution while guiding long-term organizational direction.
Strong expertise in production planning, capacity planning, portfolio management, dependency mapping, forecasting, and operational excellence.
Exceptional understanding of creative development pipelines and how to optimize art and content production without sacrificing quality or innovation.
Outstanding diplomacy and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders, resolve conflict constructively, and build alignment across diverse disciplines without relying on direct authority.
Experience leading organizations through meaningful operational change, including introducing new production processes, organizational structures, tools, or ways of working while driving strong adoption.
Excellent judgment balancing player experience, creative ambition, technical constraints, production risk, and business priorities.
Outstanding communication, organizational leadership, and relationship-building skills.
Comfortable operating in fast-paced environments with rapidly evolving priorities and complex cross-functional organizations.
Passion for building high-performing teams, enabling creative excellence, and delivering unforgettable seasonal experiences at world-class scale.

AI Capability & Readiness

We believe AI will fundamentally transform how content organizations operate. In this role, you'll be expected to actively incorporate AI into production workflows to improve planning, asset tracking, documentation, communication, forecasting, content review, dependency management, and operational decision-making. You'll champion thoughtful AI adoption across the Seasonal Content organization, helping teams work faster, make better decisions, and increase creative capacity without compromising quality. We value leaders who are curious, experimental, and capable of driving organizational change as AI reshapes game development.

Bonus Points

Experience working on category-leading live service games.
Experience within mobile free-to-play game development.
Experience leading globally distributed development teams.
Experience scaling production organizations during periods of rapid growth.
Familiarity with modern AI productivity tools such as Claude, Codex, Cursor, or similar, and experience applying them to production workflows.
Experience evolving production operating models, governance frameworks, or portfolio planning processes.

At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us & embrace the adventure!

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official website and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @scopely.com.

Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact recruiting@scopely.com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice and EEA/UK Privacy Notice.

Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. Company Description:

mom'z is Europe’s leading pregnancy retreat, dedicated to reshaping how women experience the transition into motherhood. The company creates five-day, small-group retreats at private estates across Europe, designed in collaboration with leading midwives, perinatal specialists, doulas, and movement teachers. Since 2023, close to 1,000 mothers have attended, with retreats maintaining a 100% five-star rating and strong recommendations from midwives and OB-GYNs, many of whom join during their own pregnancies.

mom’z serves a highly discerning audience of expectant mothers primarily in London, with cohorts also joining from major European cities and beyond, and has been featured in leading publications such as Vogue, Elle, Harper’s Bazaar, and Condé Nast Traveler. Grounded in the belief that empowered mothers today create a radiant tomorrow, mom’z continues to grow its impact across Europe.

Role Description:

We’re looking for someone to build and run an expert's personal content channel around pregnancy, birth and our retreats - across key social media platforms (focus on Instagram).

You’ll work directly with an expert who brings the knowledge and appears on camera. Your job is to draw out the interesting ideas, turn them into strong content, direct and film the sessions, edit, publish and keep improving what works.

You’ll shape the strategy and own the execution. The person on camera should be able to arrive, share what they know and leave the production to you.

You’ll interview and film an expert, edit the videos yourself and run their social media account. You need fluent English and must be able to attend planned filming sessions in Alicante. Candidates based in Madrid or Valencia are welcome.

What you’ll own

End-to-end: strategy, plan, execution, learnings. Specifically:
Interviewing the expert and finding useful, interesting angles.
Turning those ideas into hooks, filming plans and a content calendar.
Directing and filming natural conversations and short videos.
Editing Reels, writing captions and managing publishing and routine community replies.
Learning from the response and bringing the next ideas without waiting for a brief.

Instagram is the first priority. We’re open to adapting the content for TikTok, Youtube and other channels where it makes sense. The aim is to build trust with the right audience and help people discover our retreats.

Who could fit

You have strong creative judgment, a real feel for short-form content and the ability to get things finished.
You understand what makes someone worth watching without forcing them into trends that don’t suit them.
Fluent spoken and written English is essential. You need to be comfortable interviewing and directing someone in English, as well as writing hooks and captions.
Your own account or work for smaller clients can show us what you can do. You don’t need a famous name in your portfolio. We care about the quality of your work, your initiative and how quickly you learn from feedback.

Location and working arrangement

Alicante is ideal
. Madrid and Valencia also work if you can come to Alicante for planned filming sessions a few times per month. Planning and editing can be done remotely; filming requires being there in person.
We’re open to full-time / part-time employment or a freelance arrangement
depending on the person and scope. A broader role could include filming at retreats and producing content for the wider mom’z channels. Building the expert’s channel remains the priority.

specific range depends on experience, scope, responsibilities and the working arrangement. We’ll discuss it privately at the first screening stage.

jobs.description:
Location: Barcelona

About us

We are Dragons, a global creative agency working with bold brands to build cultural relevance, connection, and long-term impact through strategy-led creativity.

We bridge digital and creative thinking, developing innovative work across skincare, healthcare, fashion, lifestyle, FMCG, and more. Our international teams in the US and Barcelona deliver results through smart strategy, sharp creativity, and meticulous execution.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Integrated Producer to lead our Production Management team and oversee the end-to-end production of Dragons' work.

This is a hands-on senior role combining creative production, team leadership, client management and commercial ownership. You will help turn ambitious creative ideas into high-quality productions while balancing creative ambition, budget, timelines and feasibility.

Our production mix is currently approximately 65% digital video and photography, 25% event coverage and 10% 360 campaigns, with a strong focus on beauty, wellness, lifestyle and food.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the end-to-end production of video, photography, digital content, events and integrated campaigns.

Lead and develop the Production Management team, setting standards, workflows and priorities.

Translate creative briefs into strong, achievable production approaches.

Identify the right directors, photographers, DOPs, stylists, production companies and other creative talent for each brief.

Build and maintain a strong network of creative and production talent, particularly in Barcelona and key international markets.

Own production budgets, estimates and margins, finding ways to maximize production value within the approved budget.

Work directly with clients on production approaches, talent, treatments, budgets and pitches.

Collaborate closely with Creative and Account to ensure the creative vision is successfully translated into production.

Identify opportunities to elevate the work while balancing quality, cost, timing and feasibility.

Drive consistent and efficient production processes as the department scales.

Ensure production workflows are managed effectively across Wrike and Realm.

Manage multiple productions and sets simultaneously when required.

Key Requirements

8+ years’ experience in advertising, creative agencies, branded content, audiovisual or photography production.

Proven track record delivering high-quality video, photography and digital productions end-to-end.

Strong, current network of directors, photographers, DOPs, stylists and production partners in Barcelona.

Experience leading production teams and managing multiple projects simultaneously.

Strong experience with production budgets, estimates and commercial negotiations.

Confident working directly with clients and creative teams, including pitches and presentations.

Strong creative judgement, visual eye and problem-solving skills.

Fluent English and Spanish.

Highly organized, collaborative and comfortable in a fast-paced international environment.

Nice to Have

Experience in beauty, wellness, lifestyle or food.

International production experience.

Experience with Wrike, Realm or similar production/project management platforms.

A strong network across European and US production markets.

About the person

You are a senior producer who can see both the creative and commercial picture.

You know how to find the right talent for a brief, build a production that delivers against the creative ambition, and make the numbers work. You are confident enough to challenge ideas when needed, but resourceful enough to find a solution rather than simply say no.

You enjoy working with creative teams, clients and production partners, and are equally comfortable leading a team and getting into the detail when required.

Most importantly, you are proactive, connected, commercially minded and passionate about making great work happen.

Languages

English (mandatory)

Spanish (mandatory)

Any other languages are a plus.

What we offer

Remote flex Fridays from 9:00 AM to 2.30 PM.

Three weeks of remote work per year.

Summer working hours across July and August (9:00 AM to 4.00 PM).

Free English & Spanish classes to boost your global communication skills.

Access to Wellhub, a wellness platform offering a wide range of fitness and wellbeing options.

Flexible retribution plan for meals, transport and childcare.

Holidays: 22 working days + 3 days established by the collective agreement + national and local public holidays.

Bright, spacious offices in the heart of Barcelona.

Competitive salary with real growth opportunities.

A global environment, cutting-edge tools, and a culture driven by trends and innovation.

At Dragons Group, we are dedicated to creating a workplace that values diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and strive to build an environment where every individual feels empowered and respected.

to join the team.

Role:
As a Creative Producer
, you are the key link between the client, the creative team and the Post-Production team. You take creative ideas and turn them into clear and structured production plans, managing the project from concept development and pre-production through production, post-production, and final delivery.

You are hands-on throughout the entire process, balancing creative ambition with budgets, timelines, production requirements, and client expectations. You ensure that the creative vision remains at the centre of the project while keeping all stakeholders aligned and the production moving forward.

The role requires someone who can confidently move between creative discussions, client communication and post-production workflows. Someone who understands both the big picture and the details needed to make a project happen.

What You’ll Do:

Act as the key liaison between the clients, creative team, and internal teams.
Work closely with agency stakeholders, and the Post-Production team to understand and translate creative concepts into concrete production plans.
Manage projects from initial concept and briefing through pre-production, production, post-production, and final delivery.
Participate in creative and client meetings, helping shape ideas into realistic and achievable production approaches.
Prepare briefs, timelines, budgets, quotations, and presentations in collaboration with the relevant teams.
Coordinate the bidding and production process, ensuring that creative requirements, budgets, schedules, and deliverables are clearly defined.
Work closely with directors, producers, artists, editors, animators, 3D and AI artists, and other creative and technical partners throughout the project.
Keep projects on brief, on schedule, and within the agreed budget.
Continuously monitor project timelines, milestones, deliverables, and client deadlines, proactively identifying and resolving potential issues.
Maintain clear communication between all stakeholders and ensure that relevant information reaches the right people at the right time.
Oversee post-production workflows and ensure that the final output remains aligned with the original creative vision.
Participate in client presentations, reviews, and feedback sessions, translating feedback into clear and actionable tasks for the production and creative teams.
Manage changes, challenges, and unexpected issues with a proactive, solution-oriented approach.
Conduct project debriefs and ensure that project materials are properly documented and archived upon completion.
Identify opportunities to expand the scope of projects and introduce additional production, post-production, content, or AI-driven solutions where relevant.

What You Bring:

Minimum 3 years of relevant experience as an Agency Producer, Project Manager, Account Manager, or in a similar role within a creative agency or production company.
Solid understanding of the advertising and film production process, including concept development, pre-production, production, generative AI and post-production.
Fluent English proficiency; Hungarian is required, German is a plus
Strong project management skills, with proven experience managing multiple projects, deadlines, budgets, and stakeholders simultaneously.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to confidently communicate with clients, creative teams, directors, and artists.
Highly organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to keep track of multiple moving parts without losing sight of the bigger picture.
A proactive and solution-oriented mindset. You anticipate challenges rather than simply react to them.
Strong understanding of creative development and the ability to translate creative ideas into realistic production solutions.
Commercial awareness and confidence working with budgets, quotations, production costs, and timelines.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly.
Familiarity with post-production and AI workflows and software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Nuke, Cinema 4D, or Houdini. Just understanding their purpose and workflow without necessarily needing to operate them.
Experience with project management or task-tracking tools such as Monday.com or similar platforms is a plus.
A collaborative mindset and the ability to act as the communication bridge between creative, production, client service, and post-production teams.

jobs.title: Creative Strategist - Performance Marketing (Remote in UK)
jobs.description:
Creative Strategist - Performance Marketing

Location: Remote In UK or Hybrid with occasional travel to our central London Office

About The Role

PetLab Co. is a world leader in the DTC pet supplement market with a 9-figure revenue, profitable and rapidly growing globally.

In the world of performance marketing (especially for brands like PetLabCo.), a Creative Strategist is the bridge between the Media Buying team (the numbers) and the Creative team (the visuals).

Think of them as a data-driven storyteller. Their job is to ensure that every pixel and every word in an ad is designed to convert, based on actual performance data rather than gut feeling.

This role sits at the intersection of creative thinking, data analysis, and growth marketing. You’ll partner closely with our Paid Media, Video Producers, Organic Social, and Influencer teams to develop high-performing ad creatives that scale customer acquisition and revenue.

Who Will You Report Into?

Hi, I’m Jesper Mansson, Director of Creative Strategy
, and we’re seeking a senior-level creative thinker who is obsessed with direct response, passionate about performance, and knows how to lead content strategy that scales.

You’ll be a core strategic partner to our paid, organic, and influencer teams, with a direct impact on how we acquire and retain customers.

If you live and breathe performance creative and want to help shape the future of a 9-figure DTC business, let’s talk

What You'll Be Responsible For

Data Analysis & Performance Auditing – You’ll spend a significant amount of time inside ad platforms (Meta, TikTok, YouTube) Identifying what’s working and why. This will include:
Analyzing performance metrics such as Hook Rate (3-second views / impressions), Hold Rate (average watch time), CTR, CPA, and ROAS
Identifying winning creative patterns — for example whether a UGC “vlogger” style outperforms highly produced brand content
Conducting creative audits to identify which customer pain points resonate most with audiences (e.g., “stinky breath” vs. “expensive vet bills”)
Translating performance data into clear creative insights and opportunities
The goal: turn data into creative direction.
Creative Ideation & Scriptwriting - Once the data reveals opportunities, You will design the next creative tests. This will include:
Concept development creating the “big idea” for campaigns and ad series
Direct-response scriptwriting using proven frameworks such as AIDA (Attention, Interest, Desire, Action)
Writing high-impact hooks, body copy, and calls-to-action designed to drive conversions
Storyboarding content to ensure something visually engaging happens every 2–3 seconds to maintain retention
Developing creative angles aligned with DTC customer journeys and content funnels

You will be responsible for generating large volumes of structured creative tests designed to scale winning concepts.

Production Management & Creative Briefing- You willact as the director and translator between strategy and production. This will include:
Briefing UGC creators and influencers, including hooks to film, key talking points, and specific B-roll shots Providing detailed production briefs that editors and creators can execute quickly Reviewing and providing feedback on drafts from editors and creators
Ensuring text overlays, pacing, and visual storytelling align with performance best practices
Maintaining a library of high-performing assets and reusable footage
Your goal is to turn strategy into scalable content production.
Testing Strategy & Iteration – You will design and manage the creative testing roadmap for our paid channels. This will include:
Designing structured A/B tests that isolate one variable at a time (e.g., Hook A vs Hook B)
Iterating on winning ads by refining hooks, pacing, messaging, or visuals
Identifying drop-off points in videos and optimizing content accordingly
Conducting competitor and market research to stay on top of emerging creative trends
Ensuring PetLab’s ads remain native to each platform’s

The goal: continuously improve creative performance through structured experimentation.

What Your Day-to-Day Will Look Like

50% Creative ideation and content strategy development
25% Campaign briefing, scripting, and production QA
25% Performance analysis and data-driven iteration

Requirements

We’re looking for someone who combines creative instincts with analytical rigor.

You Likely Have

3+ years of experience in creative strategy or performance creative roles
Experience working in high-growth, paid social-led DTC brands
Deep expertise in Meta and TikTok advertising ecosystems
Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret performance data to inform creative decisions
A portfolio of direct-response ad concepts, scripts, or campaigns that delivered measurable results
A proven track record of driving revenue growth through paid creative
Experience briefing or directing creators, influencers, or UGC production
Strong understanding of performance marketing metrics (ROAS, CPA, CTR, Hook Rate, etc.)
Excellent communication skills — able to present insights and defend creative decisions with data

Benefits

Private Health Care through Vitality
Generous Annual Leave - 28 days + public and bank holidays
Help@Hand – Employee Assistance Programme
Royal London Pension Scheme – We offer a workplace pension scheme with one of the UK’s leading providers of group pensions. With an employer contribution of 5%!
Enhanced Maternity / Paternity / Adoption Leave – because time with new family members is important!
Nursery Salary Sacrifice Scheme
Generous Learning and development budget – We always want you to keep learning.
Puppy Therapy – working in partnership with Paws in Work to provide a boost of oxytocin once a year.
Free breakfast, fruits and snacks – refuel and revitalise with free munchies in the office.
Working Environment – dogs are welcome!
Life Assurance – In the event of your death, while employed by us, your chosen beneficiaries will be provided with a tax-free lump sum equivalent of four times your basic salary.
Discount Vouchers & Gym Memberships – get discounts at a whole range of retailers and gym memberships through our provider, WellHub.
Electric Vehicle Scheme – Employees sacrifice salary in return for a new electric car, typically saving 30-40% of costs through income and tax and national insurance.
Give Back Day – An extra day off in the year to volunteer plus a £50 contribution to your chosen charity.

Diversity & Inclusion Statement

PetLabCo. is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion. We encourage all applications irrespective of gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, nationality, marital status, and disability. We believe that diversity is at the heart of innovation, and we welcome passionate candidates from all backgrounds. Come join the family and see for yourself!

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager, Foundry
jobs.description:
At Instructure
, we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers.

We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in:

Foundry is a standalone division inside Instructure, built to generate new revenue with AI-built products. You’re the growth engine for the pods. In the core business, this work splits across product marketing, demand generation, content, and lifecycle teams; here, it’s one person doing all of it — finding the message that lands, filling the early-access pipeline, and turning a working product into paying customers. You’ll set positioning, generate demand, and own the funnel from first touch to renewal, working hand in hand with Pod Founders who are selling as they build. This is a blank-page job: most pods start with no category, no audience list, and no playbook, and you’ll build all three. The role reports to the President, Foundry, with a matrixed dotted line to Instructure’s Marketing leadership.

What You’ll Do

Own positioning and messaging. Craft the value proposition, naming, and packaging input for products customers have never heard of, and maintain messaging frameworks by segment across K12, higher education, and business and government.
Run go-to-market and launch. Own go-to-market readiness for pilots, early access, and general availability — timelines, channels, pricing input, and the launch assets that carry the story.
Build the demand engine. Generate pipeline through campaigns, audience building, early-access recruiting, and the top of the funnel that feeds the Founder’s selling.
Drive content. Create the collateral, digital content, and customer-facing assets that build demand and make the differentiation obvious.
Be the market and customer expert. Become the go-to expert on the portfolio’s customers and competitors, and feed that insight back into product and pricing.
Own lifecycle and adoption. Once customers land, drive adoption, expansion, and retention with consistent, value-based messaging.
Measure and adjust. Track funnel and campaign performance against pipeline and revenue, and change course fast when the numbers say so.

What You’ll Need

Five or more years in product, portfolio, or growth marketing, ideally in ed tech or a related industry, with new-product launches under your belt.
A demonstrated ability to drive go-to-market strategy and execute strategic product launches end to end.
Demand-generation range — campaigns, funnel, and audience building — not just positioning and decks.
Strong writing, with a portfolio of strategically focused content and collateral.
The ability to influence executive and cross-functional teams, and to present to groups large and small, virtually and in person.
A full-stack marketer’s range — you do product marketing, demand generation, content, and lifecycle yourself, and you market to fill pipeline and close revenue, not to win awards.

This Role Isn’t For Everyone

You should probably pass if:

You want to own one slice — just messaging, or just campaigns — and hand off the rest.
You need an established brand and a built-in audience to market into. Here you build the category.
You measure success by impressions and activity rather than by pipeline and revenue.
You want a large marketing organization with clear lanes. This is one person, broad scope, and fast.

Get in on all the awesome at Instructure!

We offer competitive, meaningful benefits in every country where we operate. While they vary by location, here's a general idea of what you can expect:

Competitive compensation, plus all full-time employees participate in our ownership program - because everyone should have a stake in our success.
Flexible work culture. Our remote, hybrid and in-office collaboration spaces vary by role, team and location.
Generous time off, including local holidays and our annual “Dim the Lights” period in late December, when teams are encouraged to step back and recharge based on departmental needs.
Comprehensive wellness programs and mental health support
Learning and development resources, including professional development tools and tuition reimbursement, to support your growth
The technology and tools you need to do your best work
Motivosity employee recognition program
A culture rooted in inclusivity, support, and meaningful connection

We believe in hiring great people and treating them right. The more diverse we are, the better our ideas and outcomes.

Instructure is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We comply with applicable employment and anti-discrimination laws in every country where we operate.

All employees must pass a background check as part of the hiring process. To help protect our teams and systems, we’ve implemented identity verification measures. Candidates may be asked to verify their legal name, current physical location, and provide a valid contact number and residential address, in accordance with local data privacy laws.

Any attempt to misrepresent personal or professional information will result in disqualification.

Du baust die Inhouse Creative Agency für Zasta auf – von Grund auf und in eigener Verantwortung. Du definierst, wie wir Content denken, produzieren und skalieren: Social-First, Performance-Driven, und mit dem Mut, Regeln zu brechen, wenn es bessere Ergebnisse bringt.
Ob TikTok-Ad, Guerilla-Dreh oder große Kampagne – du entscheidest, was wann wie produziert wird. Du bist nicht nur Producer:in, du bist Unternehmer:in im Unternehmen. Was bedeutet das genau?

Aufbau der Inhouse Creative Agency: Du entwickelst Vision, Struktur und Prozesse für eine leistungsfähige Inhouse-Agentur. Du entscheidest, welche Capabilities wir intern aufbauen und wo wir mit externen Partner:innen arbeiten.
Team rekrutieren & führen: Du stellst dein Team selbst zusammen – von Producer:innen über Editor:innen bis zu Freelance-Crews. Du führst mit klarer Richtung, gibst Ownership weiter und entwickelst Talente.
Productions end-to-end verantworten: Du steuerst Produktionen ganzheitlich - Planung, Budget, Team, Ablauf, finale Ausspielung. Paid Social ist dein Alltag, große Kampagnen dein Spielfeld.
Agil mit Content-Fokus: Du entscheidest situativ - braucht es eine Genehmigung und Crew – oder reicht Handy, Ansteckmikro, zwei Leute, eine halbe Stunde und fertig?
Budget & Ressourcen steuern: Du verantwortest das Gesamtbudget der Creative Unit. Du allokierst Mittel strategisch und sorgst dafür, dass jeder Euro auf Performance einzahlt.
Hand in Hand mit Performance & Growth: Du produzierst nicht für Prestige, sondern für Resultate. Learnings, Iteration, Skalierung – du denkst in Loops, nicht in Einzelprojekten.
Qualitätsstandards & kreative Leitplanken setzen: Du definierst, was „gut" bei Zasta bedeutet – und sorgst dafür, dass dieses Level konsistent gehalten wird, egal ob Low-Fi oder High-End.

Was Du Idealerweise Mitbringst

Wir suchen keine:n klassische:n Producer:in und keine:n reinen Agenturleiter:in. Wir suchen eine unternehmerische Persönlichkeit, die große Produktionen versteht, kleine Produktionen liebt
– und weiß, wie man b eides unter einem Dach zu einer schlagkräftigen Unit
formt. Was zeichnet dich aus?

Mehrjährige Erfahrung als (Senior) Producer:in im Social-Media-, Performance- oder Commercial-Bereich.
Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Aufbau von Teams, Units oder Abteilungen.
Tiefes Verständnis für Budgets, Timings, Crews und Produktionsrealitäten – von Low-Fi bis High-End.
Strategisches Denken gepaart mit Hands-on-Mentalität: Du kannst eine Vision pitchen und am nächsten Tag selbst am Set stehen. Du hast eine Leidenschaft für Social-First-Content und ein Gespür dafür, was auf Plattformen performt.
Du vereinst Entscheidungsfreude, Ownership und bist die Ruhe im Chaos.
Du bringst ein starkes Netzwerk an Kreativen, Freelancer:innen und Produktionspartner:innen.
Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau – für die erfolgreiche Ausübung der Tätigkeit sind aufgrund unseres überwiegend deutschsprachigen Arbeitsumfelds sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift erforderlich.

Du bekommst die Verantwortung, die kreative Stimme von Zasta
aufzubauen – mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum, direktem Zugang zur Geschäftsführung und der Freiheit, Dinge anders zu machen.

Was Wir Dir Bieten

Wir sind ein profitables Unternehmen, das nachhaltig wächst. Unser Management kennt jeden, der bei uns arbeitet.
Mit Büros in Rostock und Berlin kannst du frische Seeluft schnuppern oder dich vom Großstadtdschungel mitreißen lassen. Regelmäßige Besuche und Team-Events sorgen für das Gemeinschaftsgefühl.
Je nach Standort treffen wir uns an zwei Tagen die Woche vor Ort im Büro - dienstags und mittwochs in Rostock und mittwochs und donnerstags in Berlin. Die restlichen Tage kannst du dir aussuchen, von wo aus du arbeitest. Falls du an den Präsenztagen mal nicht ins Büro kommen kannst, gibt es Jokertage, die du flexibel einsetzen kannst.

Wenn du Fragen zur Stelle hast, kannst du uns jederzeit über jobs@zasta.de schreiben. Bewerbungen können wir nur online über die Plattform akzeptieren und werden auf anderem Wege nicht beachtet!
Wir freuen uns, von dir zu lesen!
