Autodesk Fusion is is redefining how products get designed and made, bringing CAD, CAM, CAE, and PCB together on one cloud platform at a price point that puts professional tools within reach of every engineer and every shop. That self-serve motion is a massive advantage in EMEA, where the market is defined by its long tail: hundreds of thousands of small design studios and machine shops that discover, evaluate, and adopt tools digitally. This role exists to own the EMEA growth engine, finding the channels that work country by country, converting trials into subscribers, and proving with data where the next investment should go.

What You'll Do

Own the EMEA acquisition and conversion funnel end-to-end: traffic → signup → trial activation → paid subscription → expansion — with revenue targets, not just lead targets
Champion and sharpen Fusion's PLG motion in EMEA: optimize the self-serve journey so the product sells itself — frictionless trials, activation moments that show value fast, and upgrade paths that feel natural
Partner with the Performance Marketing team to get the right channel in front of the right audience — bringing regional audience insight, conversion data, and funnel priorities that shape where and how paid investment lands in each market
Drive localization that converts, not just translates: landing pages, onboarding flows, and campaign creative adapted for priority markets (Germany, UK, France, Italy, Nordics), informed by conversion data per market
Partner with PMM, Campaigns, and Demand Gen to run growth experiments across digital, email, and in-product — a constant cadence of tests with clear hypotheses, measured results, and shared learnings that compound across teams
Build measurement frameworks with analytics that attribute performance through to signups, activations, and subscription revenue by market — and report clearly on what's working, what isn't, and what you're changing

Who You Are

5–8+ years in growth marketing, or growth PMM at a B2B SaaS or PLG company; you've owned a self-serve funnel with revenue accountability
Hands-on, not just a briefer: you've built campaigns, written conversion copy, set up experiments, and lived in dashboards yourself
Analytically rigorous: comfortable designing experiments, reading incrementality, and defending a budget reallocation with data
Fluent in EMEA growth mechanics: you understand how channel mix, CPCs, privacy regulation (GDPR/ePrivacy), and buying behavior vary across European markets, and you've marketed in more than one of them (English required; German preferred)
A strong cross-functional operator who can be the connective tissue between product, PMM, lifecycle, and paid teams
Curious about our users: you want to understand why a machinist in Bavaria or a design studio in Milan does or doesn't convert, and you'll go find out

The ideal candidate

Has built growth workflows with AI beyond the chat window. You've stood up repeatable systems, automated creative variant generation and testing, AI-driven audience or funnel analysis, localized copy pipelines, churn-signal monitoring and can show what you built and what it changed
Has scaled a market that wasn't working. You've taken a region or channel that was underperforming, diagnosed why, and turned it into a growth driver, not just optimized something already scaling
Knows how to turn product releases into acquisition moments. You've partnered with PMM to convert launch attention into signups and trials, not just traffic spikes

Who This Role Is Not For

If you need someone else to pull the data. You'll live in dashboards and build your own analysis; waiting on an analyst for every question will slow you to a halt
If you only know one playbook. What worked at your last company won't transplant cleanly across five European markets, you'll be testing your way to the answer
If "awareness" is your success metric. Everything here ties to signups, activation, and subscription revenue; if you can't connect your work to those numbers, this will be uncomfortable

How We'll Measure Success

EMEA funnel performance: signups, trial-to-paid conversion, and subscription revenue growth by market
Experiment velocity and learning: a steady cadence of tests with results that change how we invest
Quality of partnership: PMM, Campaigns, and global Growth would name you as the person who made EMEA legible

jobs.description:
Die führende Content-Agentur, für die Fashion- und Lifestyle-Branche in Europa mit Kunden wie adidas, Zalando, P&C u.v.m. Das sind wir: die Wiethe Content GmbH.

In den Bereichen Foto, Film und CGI sind wir Marktführer und kreieren medienübergreifend immer neuen Content, der unseren Kunden zielgruppenspezifisch

ausgespielt wird.

Unser Hauptsitz ist unser 11.000 qm großes Fotostudio in Bremen, in dem wir aktuell ca. 200 Mitarbeiter beschäftigen.

Wir suchen eine technisch versierte Person mit tiefem Verständnis für ComfyUI und Python, der eigenständig visuellen Workflowsentwickeln kann. Ziel ist es, unsere interne AI-Content-Pipeline für skalierbare, massentaugliche Produktion aufzubauen und zu optimieren.

Wir bieten die Möglichkeit, hybrid an innovativen AI-Projekten mitzuwirken
. Wenn du eine Leidenschaft für GenAI, ComfyUI, Kreativität und Workflow-Automatisierung
hast, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Standort: Hybrid / Bremen oder Hamburg (mind. 3 Tage/Woche in Bremen)

Aufgaben

Entwicklung und Optimierung von Workflows: Eigenständige Erstellung und Anpassung von Bild- und Videoworkflows in ComfyUI, um die Effizienz der internen AI-Content-Pipeline zu steigern.
Erstellung eigener Nodes: Design und Implementierung neuer Nodes in ComfyUI, um spezifische Anforderungen des Unternehmens zu erfüllen und die Funktionalität der bestehenden Workflows zu erweitern.
Technische Unterstützung und Schulung: Bereitstellung von technischem Support für das Team, einschließlich Schulungen zur Nutzung von ComfyUI und zur Implementierung von Python-Skripten in den Workflows.
Integration von visuellen Designelementen: Zusammenarbeit mit Designteams, um sicherzustellen, dass die entwickelten Workflows nicht nur funktional, sondern auch visuell ansprechend sind.
Monitoring und Performance-Analyse: Überwachung der Leistung der entwickelten Workflows, Identifizierung von Engpässen und kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Systeme zur Sicherstellung einer stabilen Produktion.

Qualifikation

Gute Kenntnisse in Python
Sehr gute Kenntnisse in ComfyUI inkl. Entwicklung eigener Nodes und Workflows Fähigkeit, stabile und performante Bild- und Videoworkflows in ComfyUI selbstständig aufzubauen
UI-Entwicklung für AI-Workflows ist von Vorteil (Gradio, React usw.)
Technisches Verständnis sowie Interesse an visuellem Design
Erfahrung mit Design und Linux ist ein großes Plus
Wohnsitz in Bremen, Hamburg oder Umgebung (Hybrid-Modell – mind. 3 Tage/Woche in Bremen)

Große Marken und internationale Kampagnen
Ein sicherer und langfristiger Arbeitsplatz
Ein motiviertes Team an Deiner Seite
Vielfältiges Aufgabenspektrum
Ein Arbeitsplatz bei einem mehrfach ausgezeichneten Arbeitgeber
Hohe Eigenverantwortung und Selbstständigkeit
Moderner und kreativer Arbeitsplatz
Corporate Benefits
Business Bike
Betriebliche Altersvorsorge

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Specialist - Paid Search (Web Subscription Business)
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Performance Marketing Specialist
to join our Marketing team. In this role, you will be responsible for the day-to-day execution and optimization of global paid search campaigns, with a specific focus on driving high-quality users through Google Ads & Bing Ads.

This is a high-impact, hands-on role for someone who has already operated at scale, is comfortable managing 8-figure monthly budgets, and deeply understands how performance marketing works in complex environments.

The ideal candidate is highly analytical and data-driven, with a strong ability to identify growth opportunities, optimize campaigns efficiently, and continuously improve performance. You should be comfortable using data to make decisions, testing new approaches, and moving quickly to scale successful strategies and accelerate growth.

You will work in a cross-channel environment, closely collaborating with Product, Data, Creative, and CRO teams, and contribute directly to profitable growth by optimizing LTV/CAC for some of our most relevant global products.

Key Responsibilities

Plan, execute, and optimize Search campaigns across Google Ads, Bing, and other relevant search networks.
Manage and scale high-volume budgets, focusing on pLTV, ROAS, and ARPU.
Develop keyword strategies, ad copy, and bidding approaches tailored for subscription funnels.
Run structured A/B tests on creatives, landing pages, and bidding strategies.
Work with Product and Lifecycle teams to improve onboarding, conversion, retention and renewal flows.
Collaborate with Data & Analytics to improve attribution, reporting, and cohort-based insights.
Monitor technical KPIs: Track and report on daily performance.
Manage budgets and pacing to maximize efficiency while hitting growth and profitability goals.
Stay up-to-date on industry trends, automation tools, and platform updates.

Required Skills

Must have

2+ years Hands-on experience managing Google Ads & Bing Ads campaigns.
Collaborative mindset with experience working cross-functionally across creative, product, and analytics.
Data-driven with a test-and-learn approach.
Initiative: You don't just follow a plan; you propose new strategies to beat our targets
Excellent communication skills in English; Spanish is a plus.

Nice to have

Proven experience managing large budgets (€1M+/year).
Background in subscription-based businesses (Web or Apps)
Familiarity with LTV models, cohorts, churn, renewals and payback periods
Basic understanding of SQL or data visualization tools (Tableau, Looker)
Familiarity with keyword research and search intent for W2W campaigns

Bonus track

Strong proficiency in AI-powered tools, particularly Claude, is highly valued. We are looking for someone who actively leverages AI to streamline campaign creation and management, uncover optimization opportunities, analyze performance, generate and test new strategies, and ultimately accelerate the scaling of paid search campaigns.

How We Think About This Role

We're looking for someone eager to learn, highly motivated, and willing to grow and eventually take the lead on projects. A specialist who:

Is detail-oriented: You catch the small fluctuations in CVR or CPA before they become big problems
Is data-driven: You don't make moves based on "gut feeling," but on what the pLTV and ROAS are telling you
Is agile: You can pivot strategies quickly as the market or the algorithms change.
Takes ownership: You treat the budget as if it were your own and are always looking for ways to squeeze more value out of it

Why join our team

Opportunity to manage high-impact budgets in a 100% performance-driven environment
Work with a modern tech stack and advanced attribution models
A culture that values technical expertise and proactive experimentation
Operate at a level of spend and complexity few teams reach
Be part of a modern Performance Marketing organization with a cross-channel mindset
High ownership, strong collaboration with Product, Data and Creative teams

Benefits

WHY LEADTECH

Diversified app portfolio with millions of active users in a high-growth non-gaming vertical.
Mature data infrastructure: BigQuery, Looker, AppsFlyer, and a proprietary analytics stack for fast decision-making.
Experimentation culture: real autonomy to propose and ship changes in production.
International team, dynamic environment, and the opportunity for direct P&L impact.
Competitive compensation package + benefits (flexible hours, health insurance, training).

Growth and career development

At Leadtech, we prioritize your growth. Enjoy a flexible career path with personalized internal training and an annual budget for external learning opportunities.

Work-Life balance

Benefit from a flexible schedule with flextime and the option of working full remote or from our Barcelona office. Enjoy free Friday afternoons with a 7-hour workday, plus a 35-hour workweek in July and August so you can savor summer!

Comprehensive Benefits

Competitive salary, full-time permanent contract, and top-tier private health insurance (including dental and psychological services).
25 days of vacation plus your birthday off, with flexible vacation options—no blackout days!

Unique Perks

If you wish to come, in our office in Barcelona you’ll find it complete with free coffee, fresh fruit, snacks, a game room, and a rooftop terrace with stunning Mediterranean views.
Additional benefits include ticket restaurant and nursery vouchers, paid directly from your gross salary.
Join us in an environment where you’re free to innovate, learn, and grow alongside passionate professionals. At Leadtech, you’ll tackle exciting challenges and be part of a vibrant team dedicated to delivering exceptional user experiences

Sounds good? Apply now! We’re looking forward to getting to know you.

Equal Employment Opportunity Employer

Leadtech is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Employer, which means we encourage applications from people with different backgrounds, interests, and personal circumstances. Our team welcomes applicants regardless of their race, gender, age, religion, nationality, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expressión and/or disabilities. All we need is your high energy, skills, and willingness to be a part of a great project!

Location

You'll have the flexibility to choose whether you'd like to come to the office every day, from time to time, or work fully remote. We want you to find the best combination for you.

If you prefer to be surrounded with amazing people, our exceptional office is in Barcelona’s Blue Building, located right on the city's seafront. Besides our stunning views, you’ll enjoy our office perks such as free fruit, snacks, and coffee and you’ll also be able to take part in our Mario Kart and table tennis competitions.

If you wish, you can exercise your rights of access, rectification or cancellation by writing to our address (Avenida Litoral, 12-14, 5ta planta. Barcelona. 08005) or to the email address privacy@leadtech.com .

jobs.title: Senior Creative Producer
jobs.description:
Who We Are Is What We Do.

Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly.

Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers.

Why should you be part of our success story?

As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are.

Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50, Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator's top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google.

Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Senior
Creative Producer
who turns bold ideas into campaigns people actually talk about.

This isn’t traditional brand marketing. You’ll create viral social content, experiential activations, creator partnerships, gifting campaigns, physical stunts and cultural moments designed to get millions of people talking about Deel.

Recent work has included a Pimp My Ride -style office transformation, creator-led social series, highly shareable gifting campaigns and global celebrity partnerships.

You’ll have the budget, ownership and freedom to move fast
. One week you might be filming with creators, the next launching an activation or turning a cultural moment into a campaign.

If you can come up with an idea Monday, make it Tuesday, launch Wednesday and measure it Friday - you’ll fit right in.

What You’ll Do

Campaigns & Creative

Lead campaigns from idea through execution.
Develop work built for organic reach, earned media and conversation.
Partner with creative teams, agencies and production partners.
Make campaigns measurable against brand awareness goals.

Social & Content

Create social-first campaigns across TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube and emerging platforms.
Produce short-form video and recurring social series.
Spot trends and turn them into opportunities.
Create reactive content around culture and the internet.

Experiential & Activations

Produce memorable activations, events and physical stunts.
Create experiences people want to attend, film and share.
Manage production, logistics, budgets and timelines.
Bring sponsorships and partnerships to life creatively.

Creators & Talent

Build relationships with creators, influencers and talent.
Identify, brief and manage the right partners for each campaign.
Develop scalable creator and ambassador programmes.

Innovation

Constantly test new ideas, formats and channels.
Run fast experiments and iterate based on results.
Push Deel to do things competitors wouldn’t.

What We’re Looking For

4-8+ years in brand, social, experiential or creative marketing.
A track record of campaigns generating significant organic reach or earned media.
Deep understanding of social platforms and internet culture.
Experience producing activations, events or campaigns.
Strong creative, project management and copywriting skills.
Comfortable working with creators, agencies and production partners.
Data-driven and able to measure what worked.
Highly organised, hands-on and able to move at speed.

You’ll thrive here if you’re

Creative. Entrepreneurial. Internet-obsessed. Resourceful. Low ego. Curious. Willing to take smart risks.

Most importantly, you don’t wait for permission to make something happen.

Total Rewards

Our workforce deserves fair and competitive pay that meets them where they are. With scalable benefits, rewards, and perks, our total rewards programs reflect our commitment to inclusivity and access for all.

Our salary range reflects gross base salary. For commercial roles with commission eligibility, this figure represents On-Target Earnings (OTE), inclusive of base salary and target commission.
Salary ranges are quoted in USD as a consistent global reference. Your offer will be localized to your country's currency using a market-aligned conversion.
Final pay is based on objective, job-related criteria including experience, skills, and location.
We don't ask about salary history. Offers are based on the role and what you bring to it.

Some things you'll enjoy

Stock grant opportunities dependent on your role, employment status and location
Additional perks and benefits based on your employment status and country
Optional flexible working office membership, with IWG

Unless otherwise agreed, we will communicate with job applicants using Deel-specific emails, which include @ deel.com and other acquired company emails like @ payspace.com and @ paygroup.com . You can view the most up-to-date job listings at Deel by visiting our careers page .

We will provide application and/or interview accommodations on request throughout the recruitment, selection and assessment process for applicants with disabilities or other needs. If you require application and/or interview accommodations, please inform our Talent Acquisition Team via email (recruiting@deel.com) and a team member will be in touch to ensure your equal participation.

As part of our hiring process, we primarily rely on interviews and role-related assessments. In limited cases, we may also consider informal background information relevant to the role, in line with our privacy and fairness obligations.

This application process may utilise Automated Employment Decision Tools (AEDT) and AI systems to assist in evaluating candidates based on experience level, technical skills and qualifications. VML is a leading creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce, creating connected brands to drive growth. Ego-less | We all wear the hats that need wearing, it’s a mentality that makes the team successful.

A minimum of 10 years of experience in creative direction, preferably in advertising or a related industry.
Portfolio with successfully launched client projects on broadcast work, social and everything in between.

Solid understanding of creative development—from drafting briefs to executing deliverables.
Well-versed in scriptwriting and in crafting both short and long-form content.

Practiced time management skills and a strong work ethic.
Agriculture experience a plus but not needed.

jobs.title: Specialist, Creative Strategy
jobs.description:
**About Darkroom**


Darkroom is the leading next\-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.


At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive\-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.


Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e\-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.


What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest\-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000\) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom's role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

**About the Role**


We're looking for a Specialist, Creative Strategy to lead day\-to\-day creative execution for Darkroom's social programs — both paid social advertising and organic content \- across a portfolio of client accounts. You're comfortable diving into the feed and the ad account alike, giving tactical, platform\-native feedback on statics, hooks, pacing, captions, and edit structure for Meta, TikTok, and Instagram. You're likely a Creative Strategist, Social Strategist, or Video Editor by trade, with hands\-on experience shipping content that performs, not just looks good.


You'll work on our Performance Creative service — our AI\-powered creative engagement for paid and organic social — helping clients increase the diversity and volume of their creative program (upwards of 50\+ new assets per month) while keeping every piece grounded in what's actually driving hooks, watch time, and conversion.


You'll work daily alongside Designers, Editors, and Creative Strategists to keep the social and paid social creative pipeline moving — briefing assets, giving feedback, and translating client goals and platform data into concepts that ship on time and drive results.

***This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone (9 AM–5 PM EST).***

**What You'll Do**

* Manage day\-to\-day creative execution for paid social and organic social programs across a portfolio of client accounts
* Brief and direct Designers and Editors on statics, motion, short\-form video, carousels, and Stories, giving clear, actionable feedback on hooks, pacing, and edit structure
* Copywriting: Own creative copy for US\-based clients, flexing in tone of voice according to platform and purpose, threading the needle when clients ask you to “punch up the copy
* Own the testing and content calendar cadence — what ships, in what order, against what hypothesis or content pillar
* Translate platform and performance data (hook retention, watch time, CTR, engagement rate, saves, follower growth) into clear creative and content direction
* Partner with Paid Media to identify organic winners worth scaling into paid, and with Social Commerce on creator and UGC briefs
* Maintain quality and consistency across a high volume of social creative output, flagging risk to timelines or scope early
* Present creative and content work to clients and internal stakeholders with clarity and rationale
* Use AI\-assisted tools (e.g. FLORA, Midjourney, Runway, Claude) to increase the speed and volume of output

**You Should Apply If This Sounds Like You**

* 4\+ years managing or leading creative execution for paid social and/or organic social programs, ideally at an agency
* Hands\-on with short\-form video, statics, and platform\-native content for Meta, TikTok, and Instagram — you can storyboard, cut, and ship, not just direct
* Comfortable jumping into Figma, Premiere, or Photoshop yourself when needed — this isn't a strategy\-only role
* Fluent in both paid and organic metrics (CTR, hook retention, watch time, engagement rate, saves, follower growth) and use them to decide what to make next
* A clear, proactive communicator who gives crisp feedback to designers and editors and can present to clients
* Already using AI tools to speed up and scale creative production
* A portfolio showing paid and/or organic social work with real performance or engagement context

### **Hard Disqualifiers**

* No hands\-on experience shipping paid or organic social creative (design, video, or content)
* No portfolio link or no performance/engagement context
* Strategy\-only with no execution ability
* Not comfortable presenting work to clients

**What It's Like to Work at Darkroom**


Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world\-class talent building something remarkable.


We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

* **Unlimited PTO \+ Local holidays (Relevant to your hub):** Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.
* **Remote\-First Culture:** Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in\-office time. Hub locations include the Brazil and Spain.

jobs.title: Technical Content Lead
jobs.description:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data.

We're hiring one person to own content at Soda, end to end.

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues.

The Role

The website. Technical blogs, webinars, and product videos. Your own content and following.

One person cannot hand-make all of that. So you'll build the system that can. That isn't a stretch goal or a second phase - we don't think the job exists without it.

You'll join the Growth team reporting to a co-founder.

What you might call yourself.
Content engineer, technical content marketer, growth engineer, marketing engineer, GTM engineer, developer advocate, technical writer who got bored, or nothing in particular. We've seen this job posted under every one of those. We don't care what's on your CV. You need to be able to write and you need to be able to build, and almost nobody can do both.

Why this is a real problem and not a content calendar.
The expertise is already in the building. Founders who have argued about this category for a decade. Customer engineers who spend their week inside broken pipelines at Fortune 500s. Customers who will tell you things nobody has published anywhere. Almost none of it gets written down, and what does get out is hand-made, one piece at a time, by people who have other jobs. Your job is to get it out of their heads and onto the internet, at a volume that is only possible with a machine behind it.

Taste is the bar.
Anti-slop is the whole point. An engine that ships slop faster has negative value, and most of them do. We're hiring for the judgment to look at an accurate, competent, lifeless draft and bin it - then work out what the pipeline did wrong and fix it. The engine has to write in distinct voices: a founder sounds nothing like a customer engineer, and the output should sound like them, not like a model. Your own profile and following is part of how we'll know it works. If it can't make you sound good, it won't make anyone else sound good either.

What this is not.
You'll write code every day, but this is not a software engineering job. We're not hiring you to build product, and if you're a backend, data, or platform engineer looking for your next engineering role, this isn't it. It's also not a traditional marketing or DevRel role: no agency to brief and no conference circuit.

Requirements

You can write, and you can tell good writing from bad: send us something you wrote that a technical audience actually read. The most important line in this ad
Serious prompt engineering: multi-step LLM pipelines with structured outputs and evals, not chatting with a model. You know why the naive version produces slop
3+ years building things that go to market: technical content, growth engineering, marketing engineering, GTM engineering, DevRel, marketing ops, RevOps, or a founder background. Nobody agrees what to call this job yet. Titles vary; portfolios don't
Enough code to be autonomous: Python or TypeScript, APIs, webhooks, a database. Nothing should be blocked waiting for an engineer. We build agentically here - Claude Code, MCP servers, and agent skills are the daily workflow
Enough data fluency to be credible: you're writing for Staff Data Engineers and CDOs. You can hold your own on pipelines, data quality, and warehouses
Generalist instinct: you find the constraint and fix it, and you'd rather build the workflow than do the task fifteen more times
Independence: you don't need hand-holding in a distributed, async team across 12+ countries
Fluent English

Good to Have

You've grown a technical audience of your own: newsletter, blog, LinkedIn, open source, YouTube
Content, growth, or DevRel in data, developer tools, or infrastructure
Agentic workflows shipped to real users: MCP servers, Claude skills, tool-using agents
You can shoot and cut video yourself
Data quality, data management, or data observability industry experience

Benefits

Compensation: $120,000-$130,000 / €110,000-€120,000 per year + equity - the same band wherever you live. We don't discount for geography
Fully remote (US or EU-based), with offices in Brooklyn if you want one
All the tokens you need, across all frontier models
Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement
Colleagues in 12+ countries

Our Values

We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful decisions.

❤️ Why you will love to join Soda

Be part of a transformation: data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it
Ownership from day one: if you see a bottleneck, you remove it
International culture: colleagues in 12+ countries
Work on your own terms: fully remote, flexible hours
Paid the same wherever you are: one band for the US and Europe, no geographic discount
Your name on the work: you build your own audience on company time, and we want you to
Direct line to the founders: how Soda talks about the category gets decided with you in the room

😡 What you might not love

Rapidly changing priorities: our roadmap can pivot quickly. It's a fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done
Flexibility required: you will have to learn new things all the time
You will kill a lot of your own output: accurate and lifeless still goes in the bin
Judged on output, not architecture: an elegant pipeline nobody reads from is a failure

Hiring Process

15-minute phone screen - with a founder
Short Assignment
Craft deep dive (90 min)
Culture fit (1 hour)

We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3-5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.

2–3 new vetted creators delivering raw footage weekly.




150+ creator database maintained.




Blended cost per creator package ≤ $300.




Footage reject rate < 15%.




100% contracts include perpetual usage rights + raw files.

About Legion

Let’s be real, AI isn’t magic; Legion was built to move beyond AI hype—delivering secure, reliable systems that work alongside the people tackling the world’s most critical challenges.

Born from a Department of Defense partnership and trusted by leaders across government and enterprise, Legion embeds intelligence inside complex systems, unlocking data, accelerating human workflows, and strengthening mission-critical systems. We don’t replace workflows—we optimize them, ensuring quality, efficiency, and reliability inside the platforms our partners already use.

With world-class collaborators like Palantir, Nvidia, HPE, and Oracle, we’re building intelligent infrastructure that enhances human capability and drives impact at the edge and across a range of enterprises.

We’re looking for bold thinkers and doers to join us in shaping the future of AI that’s secure, grounded, and built to work.

Creative Director (Remote US)

***You will set the creative bar in, brand design, art direction, or creative services, in high-growth technology, AI, B2B SaaS, or similarly complex and technical markets***

***Required: A link to your online portfolio or a PDF upload of your work samples is required to be considered for this role. (see options below to provide link or upload***

The Role

Legion produces a steady and growing stream of creative across brand, demand, product, web, social, video, and events. We are bringing that creative capability in-house and closer to the team, and rebuilding it as an AI-native creative function, while keeping our agency partner for the largest and most specialized bets. As Creative Director, you are the hands-on operating core of that function: the senior creative who sets the bar, ships the work, and builds the prompts, templates, and playbooks that let a lean team produce like a much larger one.

This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role to start, a player-coach who makes the work. You will report to the SVP of Marketing and partner first across the marketing team, including Federal Marketing, Demand Marketing, Product Marketing, Digital Marketing, and PR. You will work closely with the Product team on product design direction and in-product visuals, and with GTM and Sales on enablement and customer-facing materials. You will build and manage a small flex bench of designers and specialists over time, with limited contractor support to start.

Why This Role Matters

Legion’s work spans national security, defense, intelligence, the public sector, critical infrastructure, and the national research labs, work that often matters most where it cannot be discussed. The creative function you build is how that mission becomes legible to the people who need to understand it. You will be building the creative infrastructure that lets Legion tell a hard, important story at the speed the moment demands.

Legion is a remote-first company and an equal opportunity employer. We offer competitive compensation, meaningful equity, and a culture built on ownership, discipline, and mission. To apply, submit your resume along with a portfolio or work samples.

You will work at two levels at once

At the craft level, setting the creative bar and personally shipping the highest-priority brand, campaign, product, and web work.At the systems level, building the machine-readable brand, prompts, and AI-native workflows that make on-brand speed the default for the whole team.The way we build for customers is the way you will build here: a human sets intent, AI does the heavy lifting, and a human approves what ships. This is a builder’s seat, not a brand-police seat. If you want to define how a modern, AI-native marketing team creates, ships, governs, and scales creative work, this is that role.

What You Will Own

Creative Direction and Hands-On Execution

Set the creative bar across brand, web, campaigns, events, social, video, and sales materials, and personally design and produce the highest-priority work. This is a hands-on role first, a player-coach who still makes the work.Translate complex AI, agent orchestration, edge, and national security concepts into clear, credible visual systems.Campaign and Go-to-Market Creative

Partner with Federal Marketing, Demand Marketing, and Product Marketing on demand generation, ABM, launches, education, and field events.Build modular campaign systems, landing pages, social assets, email graphics, sales collateral, and executive materials that scale across channels and audiences.AI-Native Creative Systems

Use frontier models and AI creative tools daily to build repeatable workflows that compound over time, across video, campaign kits, landing pages, social, product visuals, and decks.Turn Legion’s brand into machine-readable infrastructure: reusable prompts, templates, kits, and playbooks, with human review at the brief and the final gate, plus clear guardrails for AI tooling, IP, and brand safety.Creative Operations and the Flex Bench

Build and manage a flexible bench of freelance designers, motion and video specialists, and other contractors from the ground up, deploying them for surges and specialty work as demand grows.Own intake, prioritization, briefs, review rituals, and clear SLAs from brief to first concept to shipped asset.Product Design Support

We pay US-based creators to post on their own TikTok and Instagram accounts. The content is already made for you. You don't script it, shoot it, or edit it. You post it, and you get paid.


Cookiy AI runs creator programs for consumer apps. Our current campaign is for a photo and AI-imaging app in the beauty and lifestyle space. We're building a roster now, and we keep strong applicants for upcoming campaigns too.

Post ready-made short-form videos to your own TikTok and Instagram accounts. Roughly one piece of content per day, posted to both platforms. Drop each post link into a shared tracker within 24 hours. Keep posts up for at least 30 days. Reply to comments here and there.

Based in the United States, 18 or older. Active, genuine personal accounts on BOTH TikTok and Instagram with real posting history. Fully remote, anywhere in the US. Month-to-month contract, renewable. Realistically 3 to 5 hours a month, since you can batch-schedule two weeks of posts in one sitting. No original content creation required for this campaign. We supply everything.

Think of it as talking to a friend your own age who keeps turning the TV up or asks people to repeat themselves, and nudging them to just get it checked.

The only equipment you need is a basic iPhone, a microphone so the sound is clean, and a tripod. That's it.

You'll need to be US-based with an American accent, since the clinics are all in the US.

We're looking for two people to start a test project with, and if it's successful and the performance is better than our current creatives, we'd look at forming a long-term partnership.

That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're looking for an Associate Creative Director of Motion Design to help define and evolve how our brand moves—across every channel and touchpoint, internal and external. 

In this role, you are both a maker and a leader, a designer and animator with expert command of motion and design principles including keyframes, timing, and visual systems. Bring a strong creative point of view to every workstream, helping to define the vision, and setting the standard for executional excellence.

Maintain and evolve our brand motion language, ensuring consistency and craft across events, market launches, and core brand touchpoints. Scale motion systems and workflows by contributing to standards, templates, toolkits, and best practices. 

Manage multiple projects and programs in parallel, staying composed and effective under pressure and tight deadlines. 

Field and reconcile feedback from leadership, exercising judgment to translate input into a clear creative path forward. 

Direct, mentor, and provide clear, effective direction and feedback to motion designers, freelancers, and agency partners, raising the bar across all motion output.

A portfolio that demonstrates strong design and typography fundamentals, a range of styles, and a diversity of project types. 

Mastery of motion and design principles, timing, keyframes, and visual systems, with fluency in speed and value curves. 

Expert knowledge of relevant tools, including After Effects, Cinema 4D, Redshift, and Figma, along with modern motion workflows. 

Experience working on tier-one brand moments such as global events, major campaigns, or product launches. 

Exceptional communication and presentation skills. Can develop project and initiative presentations from strategy to execution. Able to align stakeholders around a creative vision and ask smart questions that move work forward. 

Proven ability to run multiple projects and programs in parallel, prioritize effectively, and deliver under pressure and tight deadlines. Strong time management and composure across competing priorities.

Experience leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into creative processes, decision-making, or problem-solving.

**Arbeitsort:** Remote

Über LikeTik

LikeTik ist eine Social\-Commerce\-Plattform, die Creator, Produkte und E\-Commerce miteinander verbindet. Wir entwickeln eine digitale Plattform, mit der Creator unter anderem eigene Shops aufbauen, Produkte vermarkten und neue Möglichkeiten zur Monetarisierung ihrer Reichweite nutzen können.

Für unser weiteres Wachstum suchen wir kreative Unterstützung im Bereich **UGC Content Creation, Grafikdesign und Video Creation**.

Deine Aufgaben

Du arbeitest direkt an Content für eine wachsende App und Social\-Commerce\-Plattform und bekommst dabei viel kreativen Freiraum.

Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören unter anderem:

* Entwicklung von Creatives für Performance\-Marketing\-Kampagnen
* Unterstützung bei der Weiterentwicklung unseres visuellen Auftritts
* Recherche aktueller TikTok\-, Reels\-, UGC\- und Design\-Trends
* Einsatz moderner **KI\-Tools zur Bild\-, Video\- und Content\-Erstellung**

Was du mitbringen solltest

Du musst noch kein Profi sein. Viel wichtiger ist uns, dass du ein gutes Gefühl für Social Media, Ästhetik und aktuelle Trends hast und Lust darauf hast, Dinge selbst auszuprobieren.

* dich auf TikTok und Instagram sehr gut auskennst

jobs.title: Performance Creative Strategist
jobs.description:
Are you ready to shape the ads that introduce Kit & Kin to thousands of new customers?
Co-founded by Spice Girl Emma Bunton, Kit & Kin is a certified B Corp creating everyday essentials for families, with award-winning baby and cleaning products sold through DTC, Amazon and retail channels.

As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a Performance Creative Strategist to own our paid social creative strategy, track and analyse ad performance, and turn those insights into stronger advertising.
This is an exciting opportunity for someone who combines creative thinking with analytical confidence and wants real ownership, autonomy and impact within a growing ecommerce brand.

THE ROLE:

You’ll take ownership of the creative development and performance analysis behind our paid social advertising, with Meta as your primary focus.

You’ll be accountable for understanding which ads, hooks, messages and formats are working, which are underperforming and what we should do next. You’ll use those findings to develop successful formats further, improve weaker concepts and identify fresh creative opportunities.

Working closely with our Senior Performance Marketing Manager, internal creative team and external creators, you’ll take ideas from customer insight through scripting, briefing, production and testing. You’ll help us make more of our founder, expert, creator and product content across nappies, wipes, skincare and cleaning.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys writing a compelling script as much as analysing the results. You’ll own creative reporting and recommendations, partnering with performance marketing to translate better creative into more efficient customer acquisition.

RESPONSABILITIES:

Creative performance tracking and analysis

Own our ad creative performance tracker and weekly reporting, clearly identifying what is working, what isn’t and the recommended next steps.
Establish consistent naming and tagging to compare performance by concept, format, hook, message, creator and product.
Analyse CPA, ROAS, conversion rate, click-through rate and video engagement alongside spend to understand commercial outcomes and where ads lose attention.
Investigate results with our Senior Performance Marketing Manager, accounting for differences in audience, placement, offer, landing page and the amount of data available.
Identify emerging winners and signs of creative fatigue, and turn findings into prioritised recommendations and production briefs.

Creative strategy and testing

Own a creative testing roadmap aligned with commercial priorities, product launches, and production capacity.
Define clear hypotheses and agree success measures for each test with performance marketing.
Develop successful formats further through new hooks, scripts, creators, lengths and product angles.
Diagnose underperforming creative and recommend specific improvements, further testing or retirement.
Document results and learnings so each round of creative builds on the last.

Concepts, copy and production

Research customer reviews, surveys, social comments and customer service feedback to uncover motivations, objections and opportunities.
Develop concepts for video, static and carousel ads, including demonstrations, testimonials, founder stories, expert advice and offers.
Work with a copywriter to create compelling hooks, scripts, headlines and calls to action that communicate product benefits clearly in our brand voice.

Significant experience within a social-first creative, editorial or advertising environment, operating at a senior or leadership level.

Position at Logitech:

Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

The Team And Role:

A leader in sustainability, Logitech designs software-enabled hardware solutions in pursuit of our mission to extend human potential in work and play.

Our Creative & Design team delivers award-winning design and creative excellence.

The Associate Creative Director is a strategically minded, hands-on creative who works closely with the Creative Director to raise the ambition, originality and effectiveness of Logitech’s creative output.

You will help shape how the brand shows up across campaigns, content and experiences, bringing together strong ideas, distinctive art direction and exceptional craft. You will be equally comfortable developing a big idea, shaping a visual world, challenging and refining creative, and getting into the detail to make the work better.

Working across Logitech Personal Workspace (PWS) and with teams across the business, you will help create attention grabbing work and creative experiences that are culturally relevant, strategically grounded and distinctly Logitech.

Your Contribution:

Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment. These are the behaviors and values you’ll need for success at Logitech.

In this role you will:

Shape creative ideas: Develop original, strategically grounded ideas that bring Logitech’s brand, products and business ambitions to life. Push beyond the expected to create work that is distinctive, relevant and memorable.

Present and influence: Clearly articulate creative thinking, concepts and rationale to senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners are what helps Logitech succeed. So build confidence in the work and use feedback to make it stronger.

Champion creative ambition: Bring energy, curiosity and a restless desire to make work that stands out, earns attention and moves the brand forward.

Key Qualifications:

For this position we are looking for you to demonstrate:

10+ years of experience with a standout portfolio of original, strategically grounded, big idea driven advertising, brand and engagement work. B2C experience is essential, with B2B experience a huge plus.
A strong track record of developing and delivering high-quality integrated creative across campaigns, film/video, social, digital, photography, experiential and non-traditional media.
Exceptional conceptual and art direction skills, with the ability to turn strategic challenges into simple, compelling and distinctive creative ideas.
A high level of craft and a strong understanding of how to take an idea from initial thought through to polished final execution.
Experience working with and influencing senior creative, marketing and cross-functional stakeholders, with the ability to clearly articulate creative strategy, narrative and ideas.
Strong presentation skills and the confidence to champion creative thinking while remaining open to feedback and collaboration.
Experience working across complex, multi-channel and global brand environments, with an understanding of how to create work that can scale without losing its creative impact.
Deep production and post-production knowledge across video, CG, photography, print and digital, with the ability to collaborate effectively with production partners and specialists.
A genuine passion for advertising, design, popular culture, technology and emerging creative trends.
A strong interest in AI and emerging creative technologies, and an appetite for exploring how they can unlock better ideas, faster workflows and new forms of creative expression.
A collaborative, curious and generous creative partner who can build strong relationships across disciplines and bring people with them.
A restless drive to create truly outstanding, culturally resonant work.
A steady demeanour, strong emotional intelligence and the ability to give and receive feedback in a way that makes the work stronger — without ego.

This is a high-ownership creative leadership role within a fast-growing direct-to-consumer environment where creative is a key driver of customer acquisition.

Performance data will guide your decisions, with metrics such as hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA, ROAS, CVR, and revenue informing what to improve and test next.

Own the end-to-end creative production process across multiple external creative agencies and an internal team, managing priorities, quality, delivery, reviews, and performance.
Lead agency relationships, including running biweekly calls, setting expectations, reviewing output, and holding partners accountable for execution and results.
Develop approximately 10 creative briefs per week using customer research, audience insights, competitive intelligence, and performance data.

4+ years of experience in performance creative, creative production, agency management, or a closely related field.

jobs.title: Senior Creative Strategist (Potential Team Lead) (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Du suchst nicht nur einen Job, sondern ein Umfeld, das deine Stärken erkennt, fordert und fördert? Willkommen bei Xevio
! Als junges, ambitioniertes Start-up kombinieren wir Leistung mit einer kreativen Unternehmenskultur, in der Teamgeist, Eigenverantwortung und Innovation großgeschrieben werden.

Wir suchen ab sofort einen Senior Creative Strategist (m/w/d) in Vollzeit
. Als Senior Creative Strategist bist du einer der strategischen Köpfe hinter unserer KI-Orchestrierung im Creative-Bereich. Du steuerst für Kunden in deinem Portfolio den gesamten kreativen Prozess – vom Writing über Design bis zum Layout – mithilfe modernster KI-Systeme. Du bist der zentrale Point of Contact (POC) für Content-Fragen bei deinen Klienten und übernimmst die Kommunikation sowie Kick-offs. Diese Position bietet dir zudem die explizite Perspektive zur Weiterentwicklung als Team Lead.

WAS DU BEI UNS BEWEGST

KI-Orchestrator*in:
Du steuerst und optimierst den gesamten Creative-Prozess durch den gezielten Einsatz moderner KI-Workflows. Dabei kombinierst du verschiedene Tools und Technologien, entwickelst effiziente Prozesse und sorgst dafür, dass hochwertige Werbemittel schneller, skalierbarer und datengetrieben entstehen.

Full Funnel & CRO Expert*in:
Du denkst über einzelne Creatives hinaus und entwickelst Strategien für den gesamten Marketing-Funnel. Mit einem starken Fokus auf Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) analysierst du Nutzerverhalten, identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale und nutzt KI-gestützte Ansätze, um die Performance kontinuierlich zu steigern.

Strateg*in:
Du entwickelst kreative Konzepte, die Performance und Markenverständnis miteinander verbinden. Auf Basis von Daten, Marktanalysen und Zielgruppen-Insights leitest du Strategien ab, testest neue Ansätze und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Creatives nachhaltig erfolgreich sind.

Creative AI Expert*in:
Du beobachtest aktuelle Entwicklungen im Bereich Generative AI, testest neue Tools und Methoden und integrierst diese sinnvoll in unsere Workflows. Dabei hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse kontinuierlich und treibst Innovation im Creative-Bereich aktiv voran.

Redakteur*in:
Mit deinem geschulten Blick für Storytelling, Copywriting und Conversion optimierst du Texte und Werbemittel. Du redigierst Assets deiner Kolleg*innen, gibst konstruktives Feedback und stellst sicher, dass unsere Creatives sowohl qualitativ als auch strategisch höchsten Ansprüchen gerecht werden.

Sparringspartner*in:
Du teilst dein Wissen aktiv mit dem Team, unterstützt Kolleg*innen bei kreativen und strategischen Fragestellungen und bringst neue Ideen, Impulse und Best Practices ein. Gemeinsam entwickelt ihr den Creative-Bereich kontinuierlich weiter.

Kommunikator*in:
Du arbeitest eng mit Media Buying, Video Editing und weiteren Teams zusammen, stimmst Strategien ab und sorgst dafür, dass kreative Ideen effizient umgesetzt werden. Dabei kommunizierst du klar, lösungsorientiert und auf Augenhöhe.

Leader-Mindset:
Du übernimmst Verantwortung, treibst den unternehmensweiten AI Shift aktiv mit voran und entwickelst sowohl dich selbst als auch das Team kontinuierlich weiter. Perspektivisch übernimmst du eine Führungsrolle als Team Lead und gestaltest die strategische Ausrichtung des Creative-Teams maßgeblich mit.

WAS DU MITBRINGST

Native Advertising Expertise:
Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung im Bereich Native Advertising mit und verstehst, welche Mechanismen erfolgreiche Performance-Creatives ausmachen. Ein reiner Copywriting-Hintergrund ist kein Muss – entscheidend ist dein Verständnis für Performance-Marketing. Grundlegendes oder weiterführendes Wissen im Bereich Media Buying ist ein Plus.

Proaktivität & Drive:
Du gehst Roadblocks proaktiv an, findest neue Blickwinkel und setzt deine Ideen eigenverantwortlich um. Dabei übernimmst du Verantwortung und treibst Themen mit einem hohen Qualitätsanspruch voran.

Tech-Affinität:
Du begeisterst dich für KI-Tools und deren Integration in kreative Workflows. Du testest neue Technologien, denkst innovativ und nutzt AI gezielt, um Prozesse und Ergebnisse kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

Kommunikation:
Du kommunizierst souverän auf Deutsch und Englisch (Unternehmenssprache) – sowohl im Team als auch gegenüber Kund*innen. Eine klare, lösungsorientierte Kommunikation ist für dich selbstverständlich.

Performance-first-Mindset:
Du denkst Kreativität immer mit Blick auf Performance. Ob KMU oder Enterprise-Kunde wie ERGO, 1KOMMA5° oder Kijimea – du verstehst die Anforderungen einer Performance-Marketing-Agentur und überzeugst durch eine proaktive Kommunikation, hohe Erreichbarkeit und Erfahrung im Umgang mit Kund*innen.

WAS WIR DIR BIETEN

Teamgeist:
Werde Teil eines dynamischen, internationalen Teams, das mit viel Spaß und Leidenschaft außergewöhnliche Ergebnisse erzielt.

Weiterentwicklung:
Wir fördern deine persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung gezielt und individuell.

Offene Türen & flache Hierarchien:
Bei uns herrschen flache Hierarchien und eine offene Kommunikation – wir haben immer ein offenes Ohr.

Events:
Unsere Events sind ein Highlight! Neben dem jährlichen Work Retreat und der Weihnachtsfeier bieten wir regelmäßige Teamevents, die den Zusammenhalt stärken und für jede Menge Spaß sorgen.

Hybrid arbeiten:
Arbeite flexibel von zu Hause oder im Büro – unser Kölner Office ist schön, aber auch Remote-Arbeit ist möglich. Flexible Arbeitszeiten runden das Angebot ab.

Moderne Ausstattung:
Du erhältst von uns alles, was du für deine Arbeit brauchst – von Laptop über Tastatur bis hin zum Headset. Alles ist auf dem neuesten Stand.

Sport & Gesundheit:
Nutze deine kostenfreie Mitgliedschaft im Urban Sports Club oder bei Wellhub und probiere deine Lieblingssportarten aus. Außerdem sorgen wir für frisches Obst, Snacks, kostenlosen Kaffee und (Soft-) Getränke im Büro sowie gemeinsame Lunch Breaks, bei denen wir dein Mittagessen übernehmen.

Deutschlandticket inklusive:
Wir übernehmen dein Deutschlandticket (Jobticket), damit du stressfrei und bequem zur Arbeit kommst!

ÜBER UNS

Xevio ist eine Performance-Agentur mit Schwerpunkt auf Media Buying, Content Creation und Native Advertising
. Wir arbeiten mit Unternehmen aus verschiedenen Branchen zusammen, um maßgeschneiderte Full-Funnel-Lösungen zu entwickeln. Unser zentral gelegenes Büro in Kölnist die perfekte Basis für kreatives Arbeiten und Austausch. Erfahre noch mehr über uns auf xevio.io.

Klingt nach deinem nächsten Karriereschritt? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf und eine kurze Nachricht, warum du Teil unseres Teams werden möchtest.

XOXO,

dein Xevio Team

  About the role


 Sky: Children of the Light is one of the most-played and most-loved games in the world, known for its art, music and emotional depth. This is a rare opportunity to shape Sky's creative presence across three regions: North America, EMEA and LATAM. Working hand in hand with our regional marketing leads, you'll shape how Sky shows up in our marketing across very different cultures, reaching millions of players.


 You'll be a creative director and a hands-on maker in equal measure. You'll lead creative concepts from insight through to execution, direct the work of our agency partners and internal teams, and produce work yourself across graphics, video and event assets. Above all, you'll make sure everything feels unmistakably like Sky while resonating locally in each region, holding one global brand together across three culturally distinct regions and their individual markets.

jobs.title: Creative Director
jobs.description:
Creative Director - Global B2B Travel

London | Hybrid

VMA Group & Jack Pascoe is partnering with a leading global organisation within the travel sector
to appoint an exceptional Creative Director
into its Global Marketing function.
This is a significant creative leadership opportunity for someone who combines big-picture creative vision with outstanding visual craft, commercial thinking and inspirational leadership
.

Operating across two established international B2B brands, the Creative Director will set the creative direction and quality standard across global campaigns, brand storytelling, digital, social, video, web, events and corporate communications.

This isn't a role for someone who simply manages creative output from a distance.
We are looking for a creative leader with genuine ideas, presence and conviction.
someone capable of setting the vision, challenging a brief, developing concepts, inspiring designers and confidently presenting creative thinking to senior marketing stakeholders, a leader who does so from the front, is capable to be hands-on and strategic, motivates and educates team members.

The Role

You will act as the senior creative voice across the organisation's global corporate marketing function, helping shape how its brands show up across markets, channels and customer touchpoints.
You will:
Set and champion the creative vision and quality standards
across two international B2B brands.
Turn brand and marketing strategy into distinctive, compelling and commercially effective creative ideas.
Lead the development of integrated campaigns across brand, paid media, digital, social, video, web, events and corporate communications
.
Shape and elevate creative briefs alongside senior brand and marketing leaders.
Lead brand storytelling and develop creative ideas that build stronger emotional connections with business audiences.
Ensure creative works across the entire B2B customer journey
, from awareness and demand generation through to conversion and retention.
Present creative concepts and strategic rationale confidently to senior stakeholders.
Protect and evolve established brand identities while continually raising creative standards.
Champion innovation across formats, platforms and ways of working.
Explore how AI and generative creative technologies
can improve ideation, production, localisation and creative efficiency.
Remain close enough to the work to personally contribute to concepts, art direction and creative thinking when required.

Leadership

A major part of this position is people leadership.
You will lead a globally distributed creative design team of nine
, including two Design Managers, with team members operating across international markets.

You will be responsible for creating a high-performance creative culture where talented people have the direction, environment and support to produce their best work.
That will include:
Setting clear creative direction across different regions and time zones.
Coaching and developing creative talent.
Building consistency and cohesion across a distributed team.
Raising standards around craft, accountability and creative ambition.
Working closely with internal marketing, content, growth and demand generation teams.
Partnering with external agencies, freelancers and specialist creative partners where required.
Helping shape future decisions around team development, creative technology and operating models.

Commercial Creative Leadership

The organisation is looking for someone who understands that great creative isn't simply about producing beautiful work.
You should understand how creative contributes to brand growth, demand generation, pipeline, conversion and customer engagement
.
You will help establish meaningful measures of creative effectiveness and work with marketing and project management teams to demonstrate the commercial contribution of the creative function.

About You

We are interested in speaking with established Creative Directors who can demonstrate a combination of creative excellence, strategic thinking, leadership and commercial understanding
.

Ideally, you will bring:

Around 10+ years' experience across creative, design and brand
, including significant experience operating at Creative Director level.
A strong design and art-direction background
with exceptional visual judgement.
An outstanding portfolio covering integrated campaigns, brand, digital advertising, video and multi-channel creative.
Proven experience leading and developing creative teams.
Experience operating within a B2B environment
and an understanding of the B2B marketing funnel.
The ability to connect creative ideas and execution with measurable commercial objectives.
Experience working across complex global or matrix organisations.
Confidence presenting creative thinking to senior marketing leaders and C-suite stakeholders.
The ability to move comfortably between strategic creative leadership and detailed conversations with designers.
A strong understanding of how creative needs to adapt across different channels and platforms.
An informed and progressive view of AI-assisted creative workflows
.
The communication skills and presence required to influence stakeholders across functions, regions and levels of seniority.

Experience within travel, technology, professional services or another sophisticated B2B environment
would be particularly relevant, although sector experience is less important than the quality of your creative leadership and portfolio.

What Makes This Opportunity Different?
This is an opportunity to become the senior creative voice within a major international travel organisation
, influencing two established global brands and leading a talented international team.
The business already has strong brand foundations in place.
The opportunity is to take those foundations further, raising creative ambition, evolving how the brands communicate, embedding smarter ways of working and creating work that is both creatively outstanding and commercially meaningful
.

You will sit at the intersection of creative, brand, marketing and technology
, with the opportunity to materially influence how a global organisation approaches creative work.
Interested?
If you are an experienced Creative Director with a strong visual and conceptual background and are interested in leading creative across a global B2B organisation, I'd be keen to hear from you.

Please apply directly or contact Jack Pascoe at VMA GROUP
for a confidential conversation.

Due to a high volume of applicants, we are unable to respond to everyone. We will get in touch if you are successful in your application.

VMA GROUP is a leading international interim, contract, temporary and permanent recruitment and executive search specialist. We are specifically focused on providing support to the communications, marketing, digital and change communities.
Our specialist practice areas cover: communications, corporate communications, internal communications, change communications, PR, media relations, financial communications, CSR, public affairs, investor relations, marketing, brand, digital marketing and agency services.
We have a reputation for providing expert consultancy services and advice, supported by in-depth knowledge of the professions we recruit for. Our thought leadership and benchmarking studies have become go-to resources for the communications, marketing, digital and change industries, supporting planning and decision-making for organisations of all shapes and sizes.
In the UK, VMA GROUP has offices in London, Bristol and Manchester but we work with organisations and individuals on a global basis.
VMA GROUP is committed to equal opportunities and is an Inclusive+ Recruiter.

jobs.title: Staff Creative Design Lead
jobs.description:
Mr Who?

MrQ - we're an awesome, award winning online casino launched in 2018. We're big on tech, big on performance and most of all - big on fun. Over the years, we have experienced explosive growth - which means we need more rock stars to join our quest for total world domination.

The Head of Creative can't be in every room, in every brief, and on every deadline at once. And a creative team only scales if craft is backed by discipline, otherwise quality lives in one person's head and falls over the moment they're busy.

This role fixes both. You're the senior craft authority who owns the design language day to day, the deputy who can steer when the Head of Creative steps out, and the person who instils the practices that keep the whole team's output consistent, on-brand and fast. You raise the ceiling by making the best work, and raise the floor by making great work repeatable.

What You Will Do

The craft (setting the standard by making the best work).

Concept and execute design across the brand; campaigns, brand assets, social, CRM, sponsorship activations, merch, the lot, at a level that defines what "good" means for the team.
Help own and steer the MrQ design language: the type, layout, colour, illustration and codes that make us recognisable with the logo removed. Evolve it deliberately; protect it fiercely.
Take the hardest, highest-stakes briefs yourself and set the benchmark others work to.
Stay genuinely hands-on. This is a maker's role, not a role that only reviews other people's making.

The discipline (holding the standard by building how the team works).

Establish and run the working practices that keep a fast team sharp: briefing standards, feedback loops, file and naming hygiene, version control, hand-off and archiving that survive real deadlines.
Own and maintain the design system; components, templates and guidelines the team actually uses because they're good, not because they're mandated.
Set the quality bar and hold it. Give feedback that's direct, useful and makes the work better, without crushing the person who made it.
Build the organisational discipline that lets craft scale, so quality lives in the system, not just in one person's instincts.

The deputy (leading when the Creative Director can't).

Represent the creative point of view in meetings, reviews and cross-team discussions when the Creative Director isn't there. Hold the line on quality and brand.
Spearhead key design initiatives end to end; brief, concept, delivery, and the people around it.
Mentor and steer the wider design team, leading from expertise rather than authority.
Be a trusted second pair of eyes and a sounding board; the person the Creative Director can hand something to and stop worrying about it.

What We're Looking For

You've spent years designing at a high level and your portfolio proves it. Not just polished, but considered. Strong ideas executed with real craft. You can point at work and explain every decision behind it.

You're digital to your core. You understand platform-native design, how work behaves across every touchpoint from paid social to product, and the difference between design that looks good in a deck and design that performs in the wild.

You're a systems thinker as much as a maker. You've built or run a design system, or set up the working practices of a team, and you've seen first-hand how much faster good discipline makes everyone. You know that "process" is only a dirty word when it's done badly.

You can lead without the title doing the work for you. People follow your judgement because you're usually right and you show your reasoning. You're comfortable being handed responsibility and comfortable handing it back up when something needs escalating.

You've got backbone and humility in equal measure. You'll challenge work that isn't good enough, and take it gracefully when someone challenges yours.

You care about casino, gaming or entertainment, or you're genuinely curious about it. You get why people play, and why doing it properly matters.

8+ years in hands-on design roles, with a portfolio that shows real craft… and teeth. Considered, not just polished. Work you can defend decision by decision, in a room full of people who know the difference.

Evidence you've built how a team works, not just what it makes. Briefing standards, feedback loops, file and version hygiene and hand-off. Working practices you personally set up, that survived real deadlines and were still in use a year later.
You've built or run a design system a team actually used. Components, templates and guidelines that stayed alive because they were good, not because they were mandated.
Proven mentorship. Designers who are visibly better because you were in the room, and feedback that's direct, useful and makes the work stronger without crushing the person who made it.
Leadership that doesn't need the title to do the work. You've deputised for a creative lead: held the line on quality and brand in rooms they weren't in, and known which calls were yours and which to hand back up.
Genuine curiosity about casino, gaming or entertainment. You don't need to be a player; you need to understand why people play.

Reporting to: Darren Suffolk

Level: 5

What We Offer

At MrQ, we take pride in providing an array of fantastic benefits to our valued team members. Enjoy a competitive salary package that recognizes your hard work and dedication. Need some extra time off? We've got you covered with additional leave days, and we believe in celebrating life's special moments, including your birthday, with dedicated birthday leave. Family matters to us, too, which is why we offer a generous four-week parental leave. Your well-being is our priority, supported by international health and life insurance. Stay motivated with wellness incentives and seize opportunities for personal and professional growth with our growth allowance. Embrace a flexible working environment that caters to your needs, and join our friendly and multinational team, where collaboration and camaraderie flourish. At MrQ, we're committed to ensuring that your experience with us goes beyond just a job – it's a fulfilling journey with a supportive community.

We are committed to fostering a workplace that values and celebrates diversity. We welcome individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we believe that a diverse and inclusive environment leads to innovation and success. We actively promote equal opportunities for all employees and strive to create a space where everyone's voices are heard and respected. Join us in our journey to build a truly inclusive workplace where every person can thrive and contribute to our collective success.

To help our recruitment team work efficiently, please apply to the role that best matches your skills and experience. Our team will consider you for other similar roles as well!
